Content: import { act, render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';
import { purchaseVehicle } from '../api/client';
import VehicleCard from './VehicleCard';

vi.mock('../api/client', () => ({
  purchaseVehicle: vi.fn(),
}));

const vehicle = (overrides: Partial<Vehicle> = {}): Vehicle => ({
  id: 1,
  make: 'Toyota',
  model: 'Corolla',
  category: 'Sedan',
  price: 20000,
  quantity: 2,
  ...overrides,
});

describe('VehicleCard', () => {
  const onPurchased = vi.fn();
  const onError = vi.fn();

  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.mocked(purchaseVehicle).mockReset();
    onPurchased.mockReset();
    onError.mockReset();
  });

  function renderCard(value: Vehicle = vehicle()) {
    return render(<VehicleCard vehicle={value} onPurchased={onPurchased} onError={onError} />);
  }

  it('disables the Purchase button when quantity is 0', () => {
    renderCard(vehicle({ quantity: 0 }));

    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /purchase toyota corolla/i })).toBeDisabled();
  });

  it('shows low-stock text for quantities 1 through 3', () => {
    renderCard(vehicle({ quantity: 1 }));

    expect(screen.getByText('Only 1 left')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('shows "N in stock" for quantities above 3', () => {
    renderCard(vehicle({ quantity: 4 }));

    expect(screen.getByText('4 in stock')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('updates the card and shows a confirmation after a successful purchase', async () => {
    const updated = vehicle({ quantity: 1 });
    vi.mocked(purchaseVehicle).mockResolvedValue(updated);

    renderCard(vehicle({ quantity: 2 }));
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /purchase toyota corolla/i }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(onPurchased).toHaveBeenCalledWith(updated));
    expect(await screen.findByText(/purchase confirmed/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Only 1 left')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(purchaseVehicle).toHaveBeenCalledWith(1);
  });

  it('shows a loading state while the purchase request runs', async () => {
    let resolvePurchase!: (value: Vehicle) => void;
    vi.mocked(purchaseVehicle).mockReturnValue(
      new Promise<Vehicle>((resolve) => {
        resolvePurchase = resolve;
      }),
    );

    renderCard(vehicle({ quantity: 2 }));
    const button = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /purchase toyota corolla/i });
    await userEvent.click(button);

    await waitFor(() => expect(button).toBeDisabled());

    await act(async () => {
      resolvePurchase(vehicle({ quantity: 1 }));
    });
  });

  it('shows the error message and refreshes on a 409', async () => {
    vi.mocked(purchaseVehicle).mockRejectedValue(new Error('Out of stock'));

    renderCard(vehicle({ quantity: 2 }));
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /purchase toyota corolla/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('Out of stock')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(onError).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(onPurchased).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });
});

import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';
import { getVehicles, searchVehicles } from '../api/client';
import DashboardPage from './DashboardPage';

vi.mock('../api/client', () => ({
  getVehicles: vi.fn(),
  searchVehicles: vi.fn(),
  purchaseVehicle: vi.fn(),
}));

const vehicle = (id: number): Vehicle => ({
  id,
  make: 'Toyota',
  model: `Model ${id}`,
  category: 'Sedan',
  price: 20000 + id,
  quantity: 2,
});

describe('DashboardPage', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.mocked(getVehicles).mockReset();
    vi.mocked(searchVehicles).mockReset();
  });

  it('renders vehicles with a result count', async () => {
    vi.mocked(getVehicles).mockResolvedValue([vehicle(1), vehicle(2)]);

    render(<DashboardPage />);

    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Available vehicles' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(await screen.findByText('Toyota Model 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Toyota Model 2')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('2 vehicles')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

Content: import { act, render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { User } from '../types';
import { AuthProvider, useAuth } from './AuthContext';

const { navigate } = vi.hoisted(() => ({ navigate: vi.fn() }));

vi.mock('../api/client', () => ({
  login: vi.fn(),
  register: vi.fn(),
  setUnauthorizedHandler: vi.fn(),
  TOKEN_KEY: 'token',
}));

vi.mock('react-router-dom', () => ({
  useNavigate: () => navigate,
}));

import { login, register, setUnauthorizedHandler } from '../api/client';

const USER_KEY = 'user';

/** Minimal consumer exposing the auth context for assertions. */
function Consumer() {
  const { user, token, isAdmin, login, register, logout } = useAuth();
  return (
    <div>
      <span data-testid="token">{token ?? 'none'}</span>
      <span data-testid="user">{user?.email ?? 'none'}</span>
      <span data-testid="isAdmin">{String(isAdmin)}</span>
      <button onClick={() => login('a@example.com', 'password123')}>login</button>
      <button onClick={() => register('a@example.com', 'password123')}>register</button>
      <button onClick={logout}>logout</button>
    </div>
  );
}

function renderWithProvider() {
  return render(
    <AuthProvider>
      <Consumer />
    </AuthProvider>,
  );
}

const user: User = { id: 1, email: 'a@example.com', role: 'ADMIN' };

describe('AuthContext', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    vi.mocked(login).mockReset();
    vi.mocked(register).mockReset();
    vi.mocked(setUnauthorizedHandler).mockReset();
    navigate.mockReset();
  });

  it('starts with no token and no user', () => {
    renderWithProvider();
    expect(screen.getByTestId('token')).toHaveTextContent('none');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('user')).toHaveTextContent('none');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('isAdmin')).toHaveTextContent('false');
  });

  it('login stores the token and user in state and localStorage', async () => {
    vi.mocked(login).mockResolvedValue({ token: 'jwt-token', user });

    renderWithProvider();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'login' }));

    await waitFor(() => {
      expect(screen.getByTestId('token')).toHaveTextContent('jwt-token');
      expect(screen.getByTestId('user')).toHaveTextContent('a@example.com');
    });
    expect(localStorage.getItem('token')).toBe('jwt-token');
    expect(JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY)!)).toEqual(user);
  });

  it('logout clears token and user from state and localStorage', async () => {
    vi.mocked(login).mockResolvedValue({ token: 'jwt-token', user });
    renderWithProvider();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'login' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('token')).toHaveTextContent('jwt-token'));

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'logout' }));

    expect(screen.getByTestId('token')).toHaveTextContent('none');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('user')).toHaveTextContent('none');
    expect(localStorage.getItem('token')).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY)).toBeNull();
  });

  it('isAdmin is true only for ADMIN role users', async () => {
    vi.mocked(login).mockResolvedValue({ token: 'jwt-token', user });

    renderWithProvider();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'login' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('isAdmin')).toHaveTextContent('true'));
  });

  it('register calls the API but does not log the user in', async () => {
    vi.mocked(register).mockResolvedValue({ id: 2, email: 'b@example.com', role: 'USER' });

    renderWithProvider();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'register' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(register).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a@example.com', 'password123'));
    expect(screen.getByTestId('token')).toHaveTextContent('none');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('user')).toHaveTextContent('none');
  });

  it('registers a 401 handler that clears the session and navigates to /login', async () => {
    vi.mocked(login).mockResolvedValue({ token: 'jwt-token', user });

    renderWithProvider();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'login' }));
    await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId('token')).toHaveTextContent('jwt-token'));

    expect(setUnauthorizedHandler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    const handler = vi.mocked(setUnauthorizedHandler).mock.calls[0][0] as () => void;

    act(() => {
      handler();
    });

    expect(screen.getByTestId('token')).toHaveTextContent('none');
    expect(screen.getByTestId('user')).toHaveTextContent('none');
    expect(localStorage.getItem('token')).toBeNull();
    expect(localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY)).toBeNull();
    expect(navigate).toHaveBeenCalledWith('/login');
  });
});

async function request<T>(path: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  const token = getToken();
  const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
  headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
  if (token) {
    headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
  }

  const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, { ...options, headers });

  if (!response.ok) {
    const body = (await parseBody(response)) as { error?: { message?: string } } | undefined;
    // Only authenticated requests should trigger the global 401 handler.
    if (response.status === 401 && token) {
      unauthorizedHandler?.();
    }
    throw new Error(body?.error?.message ?? `Request failed with status ${response.status}`);
  }

  return (await parseBody(response)) as T;
}

/** Callback invoked when an authenticated request receives a 401. */
type UnauthorizedHandler = () => void;

let unauthorizedHandler: UnauthorizedHandler | null = null;

/**
 * Registers (or clears, with null) the global 401 handler.
 * The AuthProvider registers this so expired sessions can clear state and
 * redirect to /login without the client importing the router.
 */
export function setUnauthorizedHandler(handler: UnauthorizedHandler | null): void {

export function login(email: string, password: string): Promise<LoginResult> {
  return request<LoginResult>('/api/auth/login', {
    method: 'POST',

/** Fetches the full inventory, including vehicles with quantity 0. */
export function getVehicles(): Promise<Vehicle[]> {
  return request<Vehicle[]>('/api/vehicles');
}

/** Searches vehicles with the provided filters; unset filters are omitted. */
export function searchVehicles(filters: VehicleFilters = {}): Promise<Vehicle[]> {
  const params = new URLSearchParams();
  if (filters.make !== undefined) params.set('make', filters.make);
  if (filters.model !== undefined) params.set('model', filters.model);
  if (filters.category !== undefined) params.set('category', filters.category);
  if (filters.minPrice !== undefined) params.set('minPrice', String(filters.minPrice));
  if (filters.maxPrice !== undefined) params.set('maxPrice', String(filters.maxPrice));

  const query = params.toString();
  return request<Vehicle[]>(`/api/vehicles/search${query ? `?${query}` : ''}`);
}

/** Purchases a vehicle by id, returning the updated vehicle. */
export function purchaseVehicle(id: number): Promise<Vehicle> {
  return request<Vehicle>(`/api/vehicles/${id}/purchase`, { method: 'POST' });
}

Path: frontend/src/hooks/useVehicles.ts
Content: import { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { getVehicles, searchVehicles } from '../api/client';
import type { Vehicle, VehicleFilters } from '../types';

/** True when at least one filter field has a meaningful value. */
function hasFilters(filters: VehicleFilters): boolean {
  return Object.values(filters).some((value) => value !== undefined && value !== '');
}

/** State and actions for the vehicle inventory list. */
export interface UseVehiclesResult {
  vehicles: Vehicle[];
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  applyFilters: (filters: VehicleFilters) => Promise<void>;
  refresh: () => Promise<void>;
  replaceVehicle: (updated: Vehicle) => void;
}

/**
 * Loads vehicles and exposes filtering, refreshing and local replacement.
 * Uses the search endpoint only when at least one filter is set and ignores
 * stale responses by tracking the latest request id.
 */
export function useVehicles(): UseVehiclesResult {
  const [vehicles, setVehicles] = useState<Vehicle[]>([]);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const filtersRef = useRef<VehicleFilters>({});
  const requestIdRef = useRef(0);

  const load = useCallback(async () => {
    const requestId = ++requestIdRef.current;
    const filters = filtersRef.current;
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);

    try {
      const data = hasFilters(filters) ? await searchVehicles(filters) : await getVehicles();
      if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) {
        setVehicles(data);
      }
    } catch (err) {
      if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) {
        setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
      }
    } finally {
      if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) {
        setLoading(false);
      }
    }
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    void load();
  }, [load]);

  const applyFilters = useCallback(
    async (filters: VehicleFilters) => {
      filtersRef.current = filters;
      await load();
    },
    [load],
  );

  const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
    await load();
  }, [load]);

  const replaceVehicle = useCallback((updated: Vehicle) => {
    setVehicles((current) =>
      current.map((vehicle) => (vehicle.id === updated.id ? updated : vehicle)),
    );
  }, []);

  return { vehicles, loading, error, applyFilters, refresh, replaceVehicle };
}

Content: import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import type { VehicleFilters as FilterValues } from '../types';

interface VehicleFiltersProps {
  categories: string[];
  onApply: (filters: FilterValues) => void;
}

const EMPTY_FILTERS: FilterValues = {};

/** Reads a numeric price input, returning undefined for blank or NaN values. */
function toNumber(value: string): number | undefined {
  if (value === '') return undefined;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? undefined : parsed;
}

/**
 * Inventory filter controls. Text inputs are debounced by 300ms; price inputs
 * apply immediately, but block (with an inline message) when min > max.
 */
export default function VehicleFilters({ categories, onApply }: VehicleFiltersProps) {
  const [make, setMake] = useState('');
  const [model, setModel] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('');
  const [minPrice, setMinPrice] = useState('');
  const [maxPrice, setMaxPrice] = useState('');
  const [priceError, setPriceError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  function applyFilters(next: FilterValues) {
    onApply(next);
  }

  function clear() {
    setMake('');
    setModel('');
    setCategory('');
    setMinPrice('');
    setMaxPrice('');
    setPriceError(null);
    applyFilters(EMPTY_FILTERS);
  }

  function applyPriceFilters(nextMin: string, nextMax: string) {
    const min = toNumber(nextMin);
    const max = toNumber(nextMax);
    if (min !== undefined && max !== undefined && min > max) {
      setPriceError('Min price must not be greater than max price');
      return;
    }
    setPriceError(null);
    applyFilters({
      make: make || undefined,
      model: model || undefined,
      category: category || undefined,
      minPrice: min,
      maxPrice: max,
    });
  }

  // Debounce text inputs so a request is only fired after typing stops.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      applyFilters({
        make: make || undefined,
        model: model || undefined,
        category: category || undefined,
        minPrice: toNumber(minPrice),
        maxPrice: toNumber(maxPrice),
      });
    }, 300);

    return () => {
      if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [make, model, category]);

  const inputClass =
    'w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-accent-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500';

  return (
    <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-4 shadow-sm">
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-5">
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="make" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
            Make
          </label>
          <input
            id="make"
            type="text"
            value={make}
            onChange={(event) => setMake(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="e.g. Toyota"
            className={`mt-1 ${inputClass}`}
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="model" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
            Model
          </label>
          <input
            id="model"
            type="text"
            value={model}
            onChange={(event) => setModel(event.target.value)}
            placeholder="e.g. Corolla"
            className={`mt-1 ${inputClass}`}
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="category" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
            Category
          </label>
          <select
            id="category"
            value={category}
            onChange={(event) => setCategory(event.target.value)}
            className={`mt-1 ${inputClass}`}
          >
            <option value="">All categories</option>
            {categories.map((option) => (
              <option key={option} value={option}>
                {option}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="minPrice" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
            Min price
          </label>
          <input
            id="minPrice"
            type="number"
            min="0"
            value={minPrice}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const next = event.target.value;
              setMinPrice(next);
              applyPriceFilters(next, maxPrice);
            }}
            placeholder="0"
            className={`mt-1 ${inputClass}`}
          />
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="maxPrice" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
            Max price
          </label>
          <input
            id="maxPrice"
            type="number"
            min="0"
            value={maxPrice}
            onChange={(event) => {
              const next = event.target.value;
              setMaxPrice(next);
              applyPriceFilters(minPrice, next);
            }}
            placeholder="Any"
            className={`mt-1 ${inputClass}`}
          />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-4">
        {priceError && <p className="text-sm text-red-600">{priceError}</p>}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={clear}
          className="rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500"
        >
          Clear
        </button>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/components/VehicleCard.tsx
Content: import { useState } from 'react';
import { purchaseVehicle } from '../api/client';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';

interface VehicleCardProps {
  vehicle: Vehicle;
  onPurchased: (updated: Vehicle) => void;
  onError: () => void;
}

const priceFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
  style: 'currency',
  currency: 'USD',
});

/** Deterministic two-color gradient derived from the category string. */
function gradientFor(category: string): string {
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < category.length; i += 1) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + category.charCodeAt(i)) % 360;
  }
  const second = (hash + 40) % 360;
  return `linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(${hash} 60% 45%), hsl(${second} 60% 55%))`;
}

/** Upcased initials of the make (first letters of each word). */
function initialsOf(make: string): string {
  return make
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((word) => word.charAt(0))
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase();
}

/** Human-readable stock label. */
function stockLabel(quantity: number): string {
  if (quantity === 0) return 'Out of stock';
  if (quantity <= 3) return `Only ${quantity} left`;
  return `${quantity} in stock`;
}

/**
 * Presents a single vehicle with a gradient header, purchase action and
 * inline status messaging for confirmations and errors.
 */
export default function VehicleCard({ vehicle, onPurchased, onError }: VehicleCardProps) {
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(vehicle);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirmed, setConfirmed] = useState(false);

  async function handlePurchase() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    setConfirmed(false);
    try {
      const updated = await purchaseVehicle(current.id);
      setCurrent(updated);
      setConfirmed(true);
      onPurchased(updated);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
      onError();
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const outOfStock = current.quantity === 0;

  return (
    <article className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
      <div
        className="flex h-24 items-center justify-center"
        style={{ background: gradientFor(current.category) }}
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <span className="text-2xl font-semibold text-white">{initialsOf(current.make)}</span>
      </div>

      <div className="p-5">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">
            {current.make} {current.model}
          </h3>
          <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">
            {current.category}
          </span>
        </div>

        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">{priceFormatter.format(current.price)}</p>

        <p
          className={`mt-3 inline-block rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium ${
            outOfStock ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700' : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'
          }`}
        >
          {stockLabel(current.quantity)}
        </p>

        <div className="mt-4">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePurchase}
            disabled={outOfStock || loading}
            aria-label={`Purchase ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
            className="w-full rounded-md bg-accent-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-accent-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {loading ? 'Purchasing…' : 'Purchase'}
          </button>
        </div>

        <div aria-live="polite" className="mt-3 min-h-[1.25rem]">
          {confirmed && <p className="text-sm text-emerald-700">Purchase confirmed</p>}
          {error && <p className="text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

Content: import type { Vehicle } from '../types';
import VehicleCard from './VehicleCard';

interface VehicleGridProps {
  vehicles: Vehicle[];
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  onClearFilters: () => void;
  onRetry: () => void;
  onPurchased: (updated: Vehicle) => void;
  onError: () => void;
}

/**
 * Responsive grid of vehicle cards with loading skeletons, an empty state
 * and an error state with retry.
 */
export default function VehicleGrid({
  vehicles,
  loading,
  error,
  onClearFilters,
  onRetry,
  onPurchased,
  onError,
}: VehicleGridProps) {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
        {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, index) => (
          <div
            key={index}
            className="h-64 animate-pulse rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-8 text-center">
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">Something went wrong: {error}</p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRetry}
          className="mt-4 rounded-md bg-accent-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-accent-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500 focus:ring-offset-2"
        >
          Retry
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (vehicles.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-8 text-center">
        <p className="text-lg font-medium text-slate-900">No vehicles match your filters</p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClearFilters}
          className="mt-4 rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500"
        >
          Clear filters
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
      {vehicles.map((vehicle) => (
        <VehicleCard
          key={vehicle.id}
          vehicle={vehicle}
          onPurchased={onPurchased}
          onError={onError}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx
Content: import { useMemo } from 'react';
import VehicleFilters from '../components/VehicleFilters';
import VehicleGrid from '../components/VehicleGrid';
import { useVehicles } from '../hooks/useVehicles';
import type { VehicleFilters as FilterValues } from '../types';

/**
 * Inventory dashboard: header with result count, filters and the vehicle grid.
 */
export default function DashboardPage() {
  const { vehicles, loading, error, applyFilters, refresh, replaceVehicle } = useVehicles();

  const categories = useMemo(
    () => Array.from(new Set(vehicles.map((vehicle) => vehicle.category))).sort(),
    [vehicles],
  );

  function clearFilters() {
    void applyFilters({});
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-10 sm:px-6">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline justify-between gap-2">
        <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-900">Available vehicles</h1>
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
          {vehicles.length} {vehicles.length === 1 ? 'vehicle' : 'vehicles'}
        </p>
      </header>

      <div className="mt-6">
        <VehicleFilters categories={categories} onApply={(filters) => void applyFilters(filters)} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8">
        <VehicleGrid
          vehicles={vehicles}
          loading={loading}
          error={error}
          onClearFilters={clearFilters}
          onRetry={() => void refresh()}
          onPurchased={replaceVehicle}
          onError={() => void refresh()}
        />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Result: Built the vehicle dashboard in `/frontend` using strict TDD (red → green), without touching `/backend`.

## What I changed

**API client** — [`src/api/client.ts`](frontend/src/api/client.ts:1)
- Added typed [`getVehicles()`](frontend/src/api/client.ts:88), [`searchVehicles(filters)`](frontend/src/api/client.ts:92) and [`purchaseVehicle(id)`](frontend/src/api/client.ts:104) using the existing `Vehicle` type.
- Added [`setUnauthorizedHandler()`](frontend/src/api/client.ts:71), a callback-based 401 mechanism that fires only for authenticated requests (token present). It does not import the router.

**Auth wiring** — [`src/context/AuthContext.tsx`](frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx:1)
- [`AuthProvider`](frontend/src/context/AuthContext.tsx:49) now registers the global 401 handler via `useEffect`, clearing the session and navigating to `/login`.

**Types** — [`src/types.ts`](frontend/src/types.ts:19) now exports `VehicleFilters`.

**Hook** — [`src/hooks/useVehicles.ts`](frontend/src/hooks/useVehicles.ts:1)
- Tracks `vehicles`, `loading`, `error`; exposes `applyFilters`, `refresh`, `replaceVehicle`.
- Uses search only when at least one filter is set; ignores stale responses via a monotonically increasing request id.

**Components**
- [`VehicleFilters.tsx`](frontend/src/components/VehicleFilters.tsx:1) — make/model text inputs (300ms debounce), category select derived from loaded vehicles, min/max price, Clear button, and inline min > max validation that blocks the request.
- [`VehicleCard.tsx`](frontend/src/components/VehicleCard.tsx:1) — make/model, category badge, `Intl.NumberFormat` (en-US, USD) price, stock states (red "Out of stock" / "Only N left" / "N in stock"), deterministic category-derived gradient header with make initials, disabled Purchase at quantity 0, loading state, accessible label, confirmation via `aria-live`, and 409/error handling that shows the message and refreshes.
- [`VehicleGrid.tsx`](frontend/src/components/VehicleGrid.tsx:1) — responsive 1/2/3-4 column grid, skeletons, "No vehicles match your filters" empty state with Clear action, and error state with Retry.

**Page** — [`src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx`](frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx:1)
- Replaced the placeholder with the "Available vehicles" header, result count, filters and grid. It remains wrapped in `ProtectedRoute` (unchanged in `App.tsx`).

**Tests** — added/updated failing-first suites:
- [`src/api/client.test.ts`](frontend/src/api/client.test.ts:1)
- [`src/hooks/useVehicles.test.ts`](frontend/src/hooks/useVehicles.test.ts:1)
- [`src/components/VehicleFilters.test.tsx`](frontend/src/components/VehicleFilters.test.tsx:1)

- [`src/context/AuthContext.test.tsx`](frontend/src/context/AuthContext.test.tsx:1)

## prompts-log/09-login-redirect-fix.md

**User:**

<user_message>
Fix a navigation bug in /frontend. Do not modify anything under /backend. Work test-first: write the failing tests, watch them fail, then fix.

Bug: after a successful login the app stays on /login. The user is authenticated (the navbar shows their email) but the dashboard never appears.

Required behaviour:
1. LoginPage: after a successful login, navigate to "/" with replace: true (so Back doesn't return to the login form).
2. LoginPage and RegisterPage: if the user is already authenticated (a token exists in useAuth()), redirect to "/" immediately instead of showing the form, using <Navigate to="/" replace />.
3. Registration still sends the user to /login after success, unchanged.

Tests (Vitest + RTL, mock the api module, no real network):
- LoginPage: a successful login navigates to "/" (render the page inside a MemoryRouter with a "/" route showing a marker element and assert the marker appears).
- LoginPage and RegisterPage: render the "/" marker instead of the form when a token is present.
- Existing tests must keep passing. Do not weaken any test.

Verify: run npm test, npm run build and npm run lint inside /frontend and show me the results. Do not leave a dev server running. Do not run git commit.
</user_message>

 19 | const USER_KEY = 'user';

 21 | /** Shape exposed to consumers via useAuth(). */
 22 | interface AuthContextValue {
 23 |   user: User | null;
 24 |   token: string | null;
 25 |   isAdmin: boolean;
 26 |   login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
 27 |   register: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
 28 |   logout: () => void;
 29 | }
 30 | 
 31 | const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | undefined>(undefined);
 32 | 
 33 | /** Safely reads persisted JSON from localStorage, returning null on any failure. */
 34 | function readPersistedUser(): User | null {
 35 |   try {
 36 |     const raw = localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);
 37 |     return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as User) : null;
 38 |   } catch {
 39 |     return null;
 40 |   }
 41 | }
 42 | 
 43 | /** Safely reads the persisted token from localStorage, returning null on any failure. */
 44 | function readPersistedToken(): string | null {
 45 |   try {
 46 |     return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
 47 |   } catch {
 48 |     return null;
 49 |   }
 50 | }
 51 | 
 52 | /**
 53 |  * Provides authentication state to the app.
 54 |  * Persists token and user in localStorage, wrapped in try/catch for safety.
 55 |  */
 56 | export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
 57 |   const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(() => readPersistedToken());
 58 |   const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(() => readPersistedUser());
 59 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
 60 | 
 61 |   const login = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
 62 |     const result = await apiLogin(email, password);
 63 |     try {
 64 |       localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, result.token);
 65 |       localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(result.user));
 66 |     } catch {
 67 |       // Persistence is best-effort; the in-memory session still works.
 68 |     }
 69 |     setToken(result.token);
 70 |     setUser(result.user);
 71 |   }, []);
 72 | 
 73 |   const register = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
 74 |     // Registration does not create a session; the caller redirects to /login.
 75 |     await apiRegister(email, password);
 76 |   }, []);
 77 | 
 78 |   const logout = useCallback(() => {
 79 |     try {
 80 |       localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
 81 |       localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
 82 |     } catch {
 83 |       // Ignore storage failures during logout.
 84 |     }
 85 |     setToken(null);
 86 |     setUser(null);
 87 |   }, []);
 88 | 
 89 |   // Register a global 401 handler so expired sessions clear state and redirect.
 90 |   useEffect(() => {
 91 |     setUnauthorizedHandler(() => {
 92 |       logout();
 93 |       navigate('/login');
 94 |     });
 95 |     return () => setUnauthorizedHandler(null);
 96 |   }, [logout, navigate]);
 97 | 
 98 |   const value = useMemo<AuthContextValue>(
 99 |     () => ({
100 |       user,
101 |       token,
102 |       isAdmin: user?.role === 'ADMIN',
103 |       login,
104 |       register,
105 |       logout,
106 |     }),
107 |     [user, token, login, register, logout],
108 |   );
109 | 
110 |   return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
111 | }
112 | 
113 | /** Hook to access authentication state; must be used within an AuthProvider. */
114 | // eslint-disable-next-line react-refresh/only-export-components
115 | export function useAuth(): AuthContextValue {
116 |   const context = useContext(AuthContext);
117 |   if (!context) {
118 |     throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
119 |   }
120 |   return context;
121 | }

 19 | async function parseBody(response: Response): Promise<unknown> {

 22 |   }

 26 | /**
 27 |  * Thin fetch wrapper around the backend API.
 28 |  * Attaches a bearer token when present and surfaces server error messages.
 29 |  *
 30 |  * @throws {Error} With the server's `error.message` when the response is not 2xx.
 31 |  */
 32 | async function request<T>(path: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
 33 |   const token = getToken();
 34 |   const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
 35 |   headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
 36 |   if (token) {
 37 |     headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
 38 |   }
 39 | 
 40 |   const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, { ...options, headers });
 41 | 
 42 |   if (!response.ok) {
 43 |     const body = (await parseBody(response)) as { error?: { message?: string } } | undefined;
 44 |     // Only authenticated requests should trigger the global 401 handler.
 45 |     if (response.status === 401 && token) {
 46 |       unauthorizedHandler?.();
 47 |     }
 48 |     throw new Error(body?.error?.message ?? `Request failed with status ${response.status}`);
 49 |   }
 50 | 
 51 |   return (await parseBody(response)) as T;
 52 | }

 96 | export function searchVehicles(filters: VehicleFilters = {}): Promise<Vehicle[]> {

 99 |   if (filters.model !== undefined) params.set('model', filters.model);
100 |   if (filters.category !== undefined) params.set('category', filters.category);
101 |   if (filters.minPrice !== undefined) params.set('minPrice', String(filters.minPrice));
102 |   if (filters.maxPrice !== undefined) params.set('maxPrice', String(filters.maxPrice));
103 |

import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { MemoryRouter, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import { AuthProvider } from '../context/AuthContext';
import LoginPage from './LoginPage';

const { login, setUnauthorizedHandler } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  login: vi.fn(),
  setUnauthorizedHandler: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../api/client', () => ({
  login,
  register: vi.fn(),
  setUnauthorizedHandler,
  TOKEN_KEY: 'token',
}));

describe('LoginPage auth navigation', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    localStorage.clear();
    login.mockReset();
    setUnauthorizedHandler.mockReset();
  });

  function renderWithRoutes() {
    return render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/login']}>
        <AuthProvider>
          <Routes>
            <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
            <Route path="/" element={<div>Dashboard marker</div>} />
          </Routes>
        </AuthProvider>
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );
  }

  it('navigates to / after a successful login', async () => {
    login.mockResolvedValue({ token: 'jwt', user: { id: 1, email: 'a@example.com', role: 'USER' } });

    renderWithRoutes();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i), 'a@example.com');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/password/i), 'password123');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('Dashboard marker')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('redirects to / instead of showing the form when a token is present', () => {
    localStorage.setItem('token', 'jwt');

    renderWithRoutes();

    expect(screen.getByText('Dashboard marker')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByLabelText(/email/i)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

    );

        <Routes>
          <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
          <Route path="/" element={<div>Dashboard</div>} />
        </Routes>
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );
  }

  // existing tests...
```

Wait, but `useAuth` returns object. In the mock, `useAuth: () => useAuth()`. In `vi.mock` factory, `useAuth` refers to the hoisted variable? Actually `vi.mock` is hoisted. The mock factory references `useAuth` which is defined at module top. Since `vi.mock` is hoisted, the factory is called lazily when the mocked module is imported. `useAuth` const is initialized by then. This is the same pattern used in AuthContext.test.tsx with `vi.hoisted`. Actually in AuthContext.test they used `vi.hoisted` for `navigate`. But here `useAuth` is a `vi.fn()` defined normally. The factory references the variable `useAuth`. Hmm, but vi.mock factory is hoisted above the import of LoginPage and above the const declaration? 

The standard pattern: `vi.mock('../context/AuthContext', () => ({ useAuth: () => useAuth() }))`. Since vi.mock is hoisted to top, but the factory function is not called until the module is required. The `useAuth` variable is in module scope and will be initialized. However, there's a subtle issue: if the factory captures `useAuth` by closure, and the factory is defined with `() => ({ useAuth: () => useAuth() })`, then `useAuth` inside refers to the outer variable. This works as long as the factory is invoked after the variable is initialized. Since imports are hoisted and executed first, but vi.mock intercepts the import of '../context/AuthContext' which happens at the top import statements... 

Actually this is a common issue. Let me use the `vi.hoisted` pattern to be safe, similar to AuthContext.test.tsx.

```tsx

  useAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../context/AuthContext', () => ({
  useAuth: () => useAuth(),
}));
```

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { validateEmail, validatePassword } from '../utils/validation';

/**
 * Login page. Client-side validation, a loading state and server error
 * rendering wrapped in a centered card.
 */
export default function LoginPage() {
  const { login } = useAuth();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<{ email?: string; password?: string }>({});
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);

    const emailError = validateEmail(email);
    const passwordError = validatePassword(password);
    setFieldErrors({ email: emailError ?? undefined, password: passwordError ?? undefined });

    if (emailError || passwordError) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await login(email.trim(), password);
    } catch (error) {
      setServerError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, Navigate, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { validateEmail, validatePassword } from '../utils/validation';

/**
 * Login page. Client-side validation, a loading state and server error
 * rendering wrapped in a centered card. Authenticated users are redirected
 * to the dashboard, and a successful login replaces /login in history.
 */
export default function LoginPage() {
  const { login, token } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<{ email?: string; password?: string }>({});
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  if (token) {
    return <Navigate to="/" replace />;
  }

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);

    const emailError = validateEmail(email);
    const passwordError = validatePassword(password);
    setFieldErrors({ email: emailError ?? undefined, password: passwordError ?? undefined });

    if (emailError || passwordError) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await login(email.trim(), password);
      navigate('/', { replace: true });
    } catch (error) {
      setServerError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

Add the admin UI to the dashboard in /frontend. Do not modify anything under /backend. Work test-first: for each unit write the tests, watch them fail, then implement.

Backend contract (already built, admin-only): POST /api/vehicles creates a vehicle (body make, model, category, price > 0, quantity integer >= 0) and returns it with 201. PUT /api/vehicles/:id partially updates and returns the vehicle. DELETE /api/vehicles/:id returns 204 with no body. POST /api/vehicles/:id/restock takes { quantity: positive integer } and returns the updated vehicle. Errors are { error: { message } }. A non-admin gets 403.

1. src/api/client.ts: add createVehicle(data), updateVehicle(id, data), deleteVehicle(id), restockVehicle(id, quantity), typed with the existing Vehicle type.
2. src/components/Modal.tsx: an accessible modal shell (role="dialog", aria-modal, labelled by its title, closes on Escape and on backdrop click, traps focus while open and returns focus to the trigger on close). Used by the three dialogs below.
3. src/components/VehicleFormModal.tsx: one form for adding and editing (props: mode, initial vehicle, onSubmit, onClose). Fields make, model, category (text input with suggestions from existing categories), price, quantity. Client-side validation mirroring the backend, inline errors, a loading state, and the server error shown inside the modal. In edit mode, send only the fields that changed.
4. src/components/ConfirmDeleteModal.tsx: names the vehicle, has Cancel and Delete buttons, shows a loading state and any server error.
5. src/components/RestockModal.tsx: quantity input (positive integer), shows the current stock, validation and server error.
6. Admin controls: in VehicleCard add Edit, Restock and Delete buttons, rendered ONLY when useAuth().isAdmin is true (regular users must never see them). In DashboardPage add an "Add vehicle" button in the header, also admin-only. After any successful action update the list through useVehicles (replaceVehicle for update and restock, refresh for create and delete) and show a short aria-live confirmation message such as "Toyota Camry added".
7. Handle 403 and 401 gracefully: show the message, and rely on the existing global 401 handler.
8. Navbar: next to the user's email show a small role badge ("Admin" in the accent color, "User" in slate), driven by useAuth().user.role. Update the Navbar tests to cover both badges.

Tests (Vitest + RTL, mock the api module, no real network): Modal (Escape and backdrop close, focus handling), VehicleFormModal (validation, add submit, edit sends only changed fields, server error shown), ConfirmDeleteModal, RestockModal (rejects 0, negatives and decimals), VehicleCard (admin buttons visible for admins and absent for regular users), DashboardPage (Add vehicle flow adds a card, delete removes it, restock updates the stock, none of the admin controls render for a USER).

Design: keep the existing slate palette with one accent, a red destructive style for delete, consistent spacing, focus rings, mobile-friendly modals. No new libraries.

Verify: run npm test, npm run build and npm run lint inside /frontend and show me the results. Do not leave a dev server running. Do not run git commit.

 17 | import type { User } from '../types';
 18 | 
 19 | const USER_KEY = 'user';
 20 | 
 21 | /** Shape exposed to consumers via useAuth(). */
 22 | interface AuthContextValue {
 23 |   user: User | null;
 24 |   token: string | null;
 25 |   isAdmin: boolean;
 26 |   login: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
 27 |   register: (email: string, password: string) => Promise<void>;
 28 |   logout: () => void;
 29 | }
 30 | 
 31 | const AuthContext = createContext<AuthContextValue | undefined>(undefined);
 32 | 
 33 | /** Safely reads persisted JSON from localStorage, returning null on any failure. */
 34 | function readPersistedUser(): User | null {
 35 |   try {
 36 |     const raw = localStorage.getItem(USER_KEY);
 37 |     return raw ? (JSON.parse(raw) as User) : null;
 38 |   } catch {
 39 |     return null;
 40 |   }
 41 | }
 42 | 
 43 | /** Safely reads the persisted token from localStorage, returning null on any failure. */
 44 | function readPersistedToken(): string | null {
 45 |   try {
 46 |     return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
 47 |   } catch {
 48 |     return null;
 49 |   }
 50 | }
 51 | 
 52 | /**
 53 |  * Provides authentication state to the app.
 54 |  * Persists token and user in localStorage, wrapped in try/catch for safety.
 55 |  */
 56 | export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
 57 |   const [token, setToken] = useState<string | null>(() => readPersistedToken());
 58 |   const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(() => readPersistedUser());
 59 |   const navigate = useNavigate();
 60 | 
 61 |   const login = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
 62 |     const result = await apiLogin(email, password);
 63 |     try {
 64 |       localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, result.token);
 65 |       localStorage.setItem(USER_KEY, JSON.stringify(result.user));
 66 |     } catch {
 67 |       // Persistence is best-effort; the in-memory session still works.
 68 |     }
 69 |     setToken(result.token);
 70 |     setUser(result.user);
 71 |   }, []);
 72 | 
 73 |   const register = useCallback(async (email: string, password: string) => {
 74 |     // Registration does not create a session; the caller redirects to /login.
 75 |     await apiRegister(email, password);
 76 |   }, []);
 77 | 
 78 |   const logout = useCallback(() => {
 79 |     try {
 80 |       localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY);
 81 |       localStorage.removeItem(USER_KEY);
 82 |     } catch {
 83 |       // Ignore storage failures during logout.
 84 |     }
 85 |     setToken(null);
 86 |     setUser(null);
 87 |   }, []);
 88 | 
 89 |   // Register a global 401 handler so expired sessions clear state and redirect.
 90 |   useEffect(() => {
 91 |     setUnauthorizedHandler(() => {
 92 |       logout();
 93 |       navigate('/login');
 94 |     });
 95 |     return () => setUnauthorizedHandler(null);
 96 |   }, [logout, navigate]);
 97 | 
 98 |   const value = useMemo<AuthContextValue>(
 99 |     () => ({
100 |       user,
101 |       token,
102 |       isAdmin: user?.role === 'ADMIN',
103 |       login,
104 |       register,
105 |       logout,
106 |     }),
107 |     [user, token, login, register, logout],
108 |   );
109 | 
110 |   return <AuthContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</AuthContext.Provider>;
111 | }
112 | 
113 | /** Hook to access authentication state; must be used within an AuthProvider. */
114 | // eslint-disable-next-line react-refresh/only-export-components
115 | export function useAuth(): AuthContextValue {
116 |   const context = useContext(AuthContext);
117 |   if (!context) {
118 |     throw new Error('useAuth must be used within an AuthProvider');
119 |   }
120 |   return context;
121 | }

 20 |  * apply immediately, but block (with an inline message) when min > max.
 21 |  */
 22 | export default function VehicleFilters({ categories, onApply }: VehicleFiltersProps) {

```tsx
export default function Modal({ title, onClose, children }: ModalProps) {
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const previouslyFocusedRef = useRef<HTMLElement | null>(null);
  const titleId = useId(); // or generate

  useEffect(() => {
    previouslyFocusedRef.current = document.activeElement as HTMLElement | null;
    // focus first focusable or dialog
    const dialog = dialogRef.current;
    if (dialog) {
      const focusable = dialog.querySelector<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR);
      (focusable ?? dialog).focus();
    }
    return () => {
      previouslyFocusedRef.current?.focus();
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    function onKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        event.stopPropagation();
        onClose();
      }
    }
    document.addEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', onKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  function handleKeyDown(event: React.KeyboardEvent) {
    // trap focus
    if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
    const dialog = dialogRef.current;
    if (!dialog) return;
    const focusables = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE_SELECTOR)).filter(el => !el.hasAttribute('disabled'));
    if (focusables.length === 0) {
      event.preventDefault();
      return;
    }
    const first = focusables[0];
    const last = focusables[focusables.length - 1];
    if (event.shiftKey) {
      if (document.activeElement === first || document.activeElement === dialog) {
        event.preventDefault();
        last.focus();
      }
    } else if (document.activeElement === last) {
      event.preventDefault();
      first.focus();
    }
  }
  ...
}
```

it('createVehicle posts to /api/vehicles and returns the created vehicle', async () => {
  const created = { id: 3, make: 'Honda', model: 'Civic', category: 'Sedan', price: 22000, quantity: 4 };
  vi.mocked(fetch).mockResolvedValue(okResponse(created, 201));

  const result = await createVehicle({ make: 'Honda', model: 'Civic', category: 'Sedan', price: 22000, quantity: 4 });

  expect(result).toEqual(created);
  expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
    'http://localhost:4000/api/vehicles',
    expect.objectContaining({
      method: 'POST',
      body: JSON.stringify({ make: 'Honda', model: 'Civic', category: 'Sedan', price: 22000, quantity: 4 }),
    }),
  );
});

it('updateVehicle puts partial changes to /api/vehicles/:id', async () => {
  const updated = { id: 7, make: 'Toyota', model: 'Corolla', category: 'Sedan', price: 21000, quantity: 2 };
  vi.mocked(fetch).mockResolvedValue(okResponse(updated));

  const result = await updateVehicle(7, { price: 21000 });

  expect(result).toEqual(updated);
  expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
    'http://localhost:4000/api/vehicles/7',
    expect.objectContaining({ method: 'PUT', body: JSON.stringify({ price: 21000 }) }),
  );
});

it('deleteVehicle deletes /api/vehicles/:id and resolves undefined on 204', async () => {
  vi.mocked(fetch).mockResolvedValue(new Response(null, { status: 204 }));

  expect(fetch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
    'http://localhost:4000/api/vehicles/7',
    expect.objectContaining({ method: 'DELETE' }),
  );
});

export function createVehicle(data: CreateVehicleInput): Promise<Vehicle> {
  return request<Vehicle>('/api/vehicles', {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify(data),
  });
}

/** Partially updates a vehicle (admin only), returning the updated vehicle. */
export function updateVehicle(id: number, data: UpdateVehicleInput): Promise<Vehicle> {
  return request<Vehicle>(`/api/vehicles/${id}`, {
    method: 'PUT',
    body: JSON.stringify(data),
  });
}

/** Deletes a vehicle (admin only). The backend responds 204 with no body. */
export function deleteVehicle(id: number): Promise<void> {
  return request<void>(`/api/vehicles/${id}`, { method: 'DELETE' });
}

/** Restocks a vehicle by a positive quantity (admin only), returning the updated vehicle. */
export function restockVehicle(id: number, quantity: number): Promise<Vehicle> {
  return request<Vehicle>(`/api/vehicles/${id}/restock`, {
    method: 'POST',
    body: JSON.stringify({ quantity }),
  });
}

Path: frontend/src/components/Modal.test.tsx
Content: import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import Modal from './Modal';

interface HarnessProps {
  onCloseSpy?: () => void;
}

/** Opens the modal via a trigger button so focus return can be asserted. */
function Harness({ onCloseSpy }: HarnessProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Open modal
      </button>
      {open && (
        <Modal
          title="Test dialog"
          onClose={() => {
            setOpen(false);
            onCloseSpy?.();
          }}
        >
          <button type="button">First</button>
          <input aria-label="field" />
          <button type="button">Last</button>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

describe('Modal', () => {
  it('renders an accessible dialog labelled by its title', () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    // Open it.
    screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }).click();

    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Test dialog' });
    expect(dialog).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(dialog).toHaveAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
  });

  it('closes when Escape is pressed', async () => {
    const onCloseSpy = vi.fn();
    render(<Harness onCloseSpy={onCloseSpy} />);
    screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }).click();

    await userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}');

    expect(onCloseSpy).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('closes when the backdrop is clicked but not when the dialog is clicked', async () => {
    const onCloseSpy = vi.fn();
    render(<Harness onCloseSpy={onCloseSpy} />);
    screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }).click();

    // Clicking inside the dialog must not close it.
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('dialog'));
    expect(onCloseSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    // Clicking the backdrop must close it.
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByTestId('modal-backdrop'));
    expect(onCloseSpy).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('moves focus into the dialog when opened and traps Tab within it', async () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }).click();

    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    expect(dialog).toHaveFocus();

    // Focus the last focusable element and Tab forward: focus wraps to first.
    screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Last' }).focus();
    await userEvent.tab();

    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'First' })).toHaveFocus();
  });

  it('returns focus to the trigger when closed', async () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    const trigger = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' });
    trigger.click();

    await userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}');

    expect(trigger).toHaveFocus();
  });
});

Path: frontend/src/components/Modal.tsx
Content: import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';

interface ModalProps {
  title: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  children: ReactNode;
}

/** Selectors for elements that can receive keyboard focus. */
const FOCUSABLE =
  'a[href], button:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';

/**
 * Accessible modal shell rendered in a portal.
 * Sets aria-modal, closes on Escape and backdrop click, traps focus while
 * open and restores focus to the previously focused element on close.
 */
export default function Modal({ title, onClose, children }: ModalProps) {
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const previouslyFocusedRef = useRef<Element | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    previouslyFocusedRef.current = document.activeElement;

    // Move focus into the dialog on open.
    const dialog = dialogRef.current;
    dialog?.focus();

    return () => {
      // Restore focus to the trigger on close.
      if (previouslyFocusedRef.current instanceof HTMLElement) {
        previouslyFocusedRef.current.focus();
      }
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        event.preventDefault();
        onClose();
        return;
      }

      if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;

      const dialog = dialogRef.current;
      if (!dialog) return;

      const focusable = Array.from(
        dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE),
      ).filter((element) => element.offsetParent !== null || element === document.activeElement);

      if (focusable.length === 0) {
        event.preventDefault();
        dialog.focus();
        return;
      }

      const first = focusable[0];
      const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];

      if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
        event.preventDefault();
        last.focus();
      } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
        event.preventDefault();
        first.focus();
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  return createPortal(
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
      data-testid="modal-backdrop"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/50" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div
        ref={dialogRef}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="modal-title"
        tabIndex={-1}
        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        className="relative w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-lg focus:outline-none"
      >
        <h2 id="modal-title" className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">
          {title}
        </h2>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/components/Modal.test.tsx
Content: import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { useState } from 'react';
import { describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import Modal from './Modal';

interface HarnessProps {
  onCloseSpy?: () => void;
}

/** Opens the modal via a trigger button so focus return can be asserted. */
function Harness({ onCloseSpy }: HarnessProps) {
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
  return (
    <div>
      <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
        Open modal
      </button>
      {open && (
        <Modal
          title="Test dialog"
          onClose={() => {
            setOpen(false);
            onCloseSpy?.();
          }}
        >
          <button type="button">First</button>
          <input aria-label="field" />
          <button type="button">Last</button>
        </Modal>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

describe('Modal', () => {
  it('renders an accessible dialog labelled by its title', async () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }));

    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Test dialog' });
    expect(dialog).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(dialog).toHaveAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
  });

  it('closes when Escape is pressed', async () => {
    const onCloseSpy = vi.fn();
    render(<Harness onCloseSpy={onCloseSpy} />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }));

    await userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}');

    expect(onCloseSpy).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('closes when the backdrop is clicked but not when the dialog is clicked', async () => {
    const onCloseSpy = vi.fn();
    render(<Harness onCloseSpy={onCloseSpy} />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }));

    // Clicking inside the dialog must not close it.
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('dialog'));
    expect(onCloseSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();

    // Clicking the backdrop must close it.
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByTestId('modal-backdrop'));
    expect(onCloseSpy).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('moves focus into the dialog when opened and traps Tab within it', async () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }));

    const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
    expect(dialog).toHaveFocus();

    // Focus the last focusable element and Tab forward: focus wraps to first.
    screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Last' }).focus();
    await userEvent.tab();

    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'First' })).toHaveFocus();
  });

  it('returns focus to the trigger when closed', async () => {
    render(<Harness />);
    const trigger = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' });
    await userEvent.click(trigger);

    await userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}');

    expect(trigger).toHaveFocus();
  });
});

Path: frontend/src/components/VehicleFormModal.test.tsx
Content: import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';
import VehicleFormModal from './VehicleFormModal';

const initial = (overrides: Partial<Vehicle> = {}): Vehicle => ({
  id: 1,
  make: 'Toyota',
  model: 'Corolla',
  category: 'Sedan',
  price: 20000,
  quantity: 2,
  ...overrides,
});

describe('VehicleFormModal', () => {
  const onSubmit = vi.fn();
  const onClose = vi.fn();

  beforeEach(() => {
    onSubmit.mockReset();
    onClose.mockReset();
  });

  function renderAdd() {
    return render(
      <VehicleFormModal
        mode="add"
        initialVehicle={null}
        categories={['Sedan', 'SUV']}
        onSubmit={onSubmit}
        onClose={onClose}
      />,
    );
  }

  function renderEdit(value: Vehicle) {
    return render(
      <VehicleFormModal
        mode="edit"
        initialVehicle={value}
        categories={['Sedan', 'SUV']}
        onSubmit={onSubmit}
        onClose={onClose}
      />,
    );
  }

  it('shows required-field errors when submitting an empty form', async () => {
    renderAdd();

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /add vehicle/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText(/make is required/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/model is required/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/category is required/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(onSubmit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('validates price and quantity and blocks submission', async () => {
    renderAdd();

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/make/i), 'Toyota');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/model/i), 'Corolla');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/category/i), 'Sedan');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/price/i), '-5');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/quantity/i), '2.5');

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /add vehicle/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText(/price must be greater than 0/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/quantity must be an integer/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(onSubmit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('submits the full payload when adding', async () => {
    renderAdd();

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/make/i), 'Honda');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/model/i), 'Civic');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/category/i), 'Sedan');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/price/i), '22000');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/quantity/i), '3');

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /add vehicle/i }));

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(onSubmit).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        make: 'Honda',
        model: 'Civic',
        category: 'Sedan',
        price: 22000,
        quantity: 3,
      }),
    );
  });

  it('prefills values in edit mode and submits only changed fields', async () => {
    renderEdit(initial());

    await userEvent.clear(screen.getByLabelText(/price/i));
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/price/i), '21000');

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /save changes/i }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(onSubmit).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ price: 21000 }));
  });

  it('shows the server error inside the modal', async () => {
    onSubmit.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Database is down'));

    renderAdd();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/make/i), 'Honda');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/model/i), 'Civic');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/category/i), 'Sedan');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/price/i), '22000');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/quantity/i), '3');

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /add vehicle/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('Database is down')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

Content: import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import type { CreateVehicleInput, UpdateVehicleInput } from '../api/client';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';
import Modal from './Modal';

interface VehicleFormModalProps {
  mode: 'add' | 'edit';
  initialVehicle: Vehicle | null;
  categories: string[];
  onSubmit: (data: CreateVehicleInput | UpdateVehicleInput) => Promise<void>;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface FieldErrors {
  make?: string;
  model?: string;
  category?: string;
  price?: string;
  quantity?: string;
}

const EMPTY_FIELDS: FieldErrors = {};

/** Parses an integer quantity input, treating an empty string as 0. */
function parseQuantity(value: string): number {
  if (value.trim() === '') return 0;
  return Number(value);
}

/** Validates the form values against the backend contract. */
function validate(values: {
  make: string;
  model: string;
  category: string;
  price: string;
  quantity: string;
}): FieldErrors {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};

  if (values.make.trim() === '') errors.make = 'Make is required';
  if (values.model.trim() === '') errors.model = 'Model is required';
  if (values.category.trim() === '') errors.category = 'Category is required';

  const price = Number(values.price);
  if (values.price.trim() === '' || Number.isNaN(price) || price <= 0) {
    errors.price = 'Price must be greater than 0';
  }

  const quantity = parseQuantity(values.quantity);
  if (values.quantity.trim() !== '') {
    if (!Number.isInteger(quantity)) {
      errors.quantity = 'Quantity must be an integer';
    } else if (quantity < 0) {
      errors.quantity = 'Quantity cannot be negative';
    }
  }

  return errors;
}

const inputClass =
  'mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-900 placeholder:text-slate-400 focus:border-accent-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500';

/**
 * Add/edit form for a vehicle, rendered inside an accessible modal.
 * Validates client-side, shows inline errors and the server error, and in
 * edit mode submits only the fields that changed from the initial vehicle.
 */
export default function VehicleFormModal({
  mode,
  initialVehicle,
  categories,
  onSubmit,
  onClose,
}: VehicleFormModalProps) {
  const [make, setMake] = useState(initialVehicle?.make ?? '');
  const [model, setModel] = useState(initialVehicle?.model ?? '');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(initialVehicle?.category ?? '');
  const [price, setPrice] = useState(initialVehicle ? String(initialVehicle.price) : '');
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(
    initialVehicle ? String(initialVehicle.quantity) : '',
  );
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<FieldErrors>(EMPTY_FIELDS);
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const isEdit = mode === 'edit';

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);

    const values = { make, model, category, price, quantity };
    const errors = validate(values);
    setFieldErrors(errors);
    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) return;

    const payload: CreateVehicleInput | UpdateVehicleInput = isEdit
      ? buildChanges(values, initialVehicle!)
      : {
          make: make.trim(),
          model: model.trim(),
          category: category.trim(),
          price: Number(price),
          quantity: parseQuantity(quantity),
        };

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await onSubmit(payload);
    } catch (error) {
      setServerError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal title={isEdit ? 'Edit vehicle' : 'Add vehicle'} onClose={onClose}>
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate className="mt-4 space-y-4">
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="vehicle-make" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
            Make
          </label>
          <input
            id="vehicle-make"
            type="text"
            value={make}
            onChange={(event) => setMake(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
          />
          {fieldErrors.make && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.make}</p>}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="vehicle-model" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
            Model
          </label>
          <input
            id="vehicle-model"
            type="text"
            value={model}
            onChange={(event) => setModel(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
          />
          {fieldErrors.model && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.model}</p>}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="vehicle-category" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
            Category
          </label>
          <input
            id="vehicle-category"
            type="text"
            list="vehicle-categories"
            value={category}
            onChange={(event) => setCategory(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
          />
          <datalist id="vehicle-categories">
            {categories.map((option) => (
              <option key={option} value={option} />
            ))}
          </datalist>
          {fieldErrors.category && (
            <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.category}</p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="vehicle-price" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
              Price
            </label>
            <input
              id="vehicle-price"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              value={price}
              onChange={(event) => setPrice(event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            />
            {fieldErrors.price && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.price}</p>}
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="vehicle-quantity" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
              Quantity
            </label>
            <input
              id="vehicle-quantity"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              value={quantity}
              onChange={(event) => setQuantity(event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            />
            {fieldErrors.quantity && (
              <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600">{fieldErrors.quantity}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {serverError && <p className="text-sm text-red-600">{serverError}</p>}

        <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={loading}
            className="rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="rounded-md bg-accent-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-accent-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {loading ? 'Saving…' : isEdit ? 'Save changes' : 'Add vehicle'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/** Computes the subset of fields that differ from the initial vehicle. */
function buildChanges(
  values: { make: string; model: string; category: string; price: string; quantity: string },
  initial: Vehicle,
): UpdateVehicleInput {
  const changes: UpdateVehicleInput = {};

  const make = values.make.trim();
  const model = values.model.trim();
  const category = values.category.trim();
  const price = Number(values.price);
  const quantity = parseQuantity(values.quantity);

  if (make !== initial.make) changes.make = make;
  if (model !== initial.model) changes.model = model;
  if (category !== initial.category) changes.category = category;
  if (price !== initial.price) changes.price = price;
  if (quantity !== initial.quantity) changes.quantity = quantity;

  return changes;
}

Content: import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import ConfirmDeleteModal from './ConfirmDeleteModal';

describe('ConfirmDeleteModal', () => {
  const onConfirm = vi.fn();
  const onCancel = vi.fn();

  beforeEach(() => {
    onConfirm.mockReset();
    onCancel.mockReset();
  });

  function renderModal() {
    return render(
      <ConfirmDeleteModal
        vehicleName="Toyota Camry"
        onConfirm={onConfirm}
        onCancel={onCancel}
      />,
    );
  }

  it('names the vehicle and shows Cancel and Delete buttons', () => {
    renderModal();

    expect(screen.getByText(/Toyota Camry/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('calls onCancel when Cancel is clicked', async () => {
    renderModal();

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Cancel' }));

    expect(onCancel).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
    expect(onConfirm).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('shows a loading state and calls onConfirm on success', async () => {
    let resolveConfirm!: () => void;
    onConfirm.mockReturnValue(
      new Promise<void>((resolve) => {
        resolveConfirm = resolve;
      }),
    );

    renderModal();
    const deleteButton = screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete' });
    await userEvent.click(deleteButton);

    await waitFor(() => expect(deleteButton).toBeDisabled());
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /deleting/i })).toBeInTheDocument();

    resolveConfirm();
  });

  it('shows the server error inside the modal', async () => {
    onConfirm.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Cannot delete'));

    renderModal();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete' }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('Cannot delete')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(onConfirm).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });
});
