Path: frontend/src/components/ConfirmDeleteModal.tsx
Content: import { useState } from 'react';
import Modal from './Modal';

interface ConfirmDeleteModalProps {
  vehicleName: string;
  onConfirm: () => Promise<void>;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

/**
 * Delete confirmation dialog. Names the vehicle, shows a destructive Delete
 * action with a loading state, and renders any server error inline.
 */
export default function ConfirmDeleteModal({
  vehicleName,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: ConfirmDeleteModalProps) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function handleConfirm() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await onConfirm();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal title="Delete vehicle" onClose={onCancel}>
      <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
        Are you sure you want to delete <span className="font-medium">{vehicleName}</span>? This
        action cannot be undone.
      </p>

      {error && <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}

      <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onCancel}
          disabled={loading}
          className="rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500"
        >
          Cancel
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleConfirm}
          disabled={loading}
          className="rounded-md bg-red-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-red-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {loading ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

Content: import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import RestockModal from './RestockModal';

describe('RestockModal', () => {
  const onSubmit = vi.fn();
  const onClose = vi.fn();

  beforeEach(() => {
    onSubmit.mockReset();
    onClose.mockReset();
  });

  function renderModal() {
    return render(
      <RestockModal vehicleName="Toyota Camry" currentStock={5} onSubmit={onSubmit} onClose={onClose} />,
    );
  }

  it('shows the current stock and a quantity input', () => {
    renderModal();

    expect(screen.getByText(/current stock: 5/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByLabelText(/quantity/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('rejects 0 with a validation error and does not submit', async () => {
    renderModal();

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/quantity/i), '0');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /restock/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText(/quantity must be greater than 0/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(onSubmit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects negative values with a validation error', async () => {
    renderModal();

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/quantity/i), '-3');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /restock/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText(/quantity must be greater than 0/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(onSubmit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('rejects decimals with a validation error', async () => {
    renderModal();

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/quantity/i), '2.5');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /restock/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText(/quantity must be an integer/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(onSubmit).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('submits the positive integer quantity', async () => {
    renderModal();

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/quantity/i), '4');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /restock/i }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(onSubmit).toHaveBeenCalledWith(4));
  });

  it('shows the server error inside the modal', async () => {
    onSubmit.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Restock failed'));

    renderModal();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/quantity/i), '4');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /restock/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('Restock failed')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

Path: frontend/src/components/RestockModal.tsx
Content: import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import Modal from './Modal';

interface RestockModalProps {
  vehicleName: string;
  currentStock: number;
  onSubmit: (quantity: number) => Promise<void>;
  onClose: () => void;
}

/**
 * Restock dialog. Accepts a positive integer quantity, shows the current
 * stock, validates client-side and renders any server error inline.
 */
export default function RestockModal({
  vehicleName,
  currentStock,
  onSubmit,
  onClose,
}: RestockModalProps) {
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    const parsed = Number(quantity);
    if (quantity.trim() === '' || Number.isNaN(parsed) || parsed <= 0) {
      setError('Quantity must be greater than 0');
      return;
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(parsed)) {
      setError('Quantity must be an integer');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await onSubmit(parsed);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal title="Restock vehicle" onClose={onClose}>
      <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-slate-600">
        {vehicleName} — current stock: <span className="font-medium">{currentStock}</span>
      </p>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate className="mt-4 space-y-4">
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="restock-quantity" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-700">
            Quantity to add
          </label>
          <input
            id="restock-quantity"
            type="number"
            min="1"
            value={quantity}
            onChange={(event) => setQuantity(event.target.value)}
            className="mt-1 w-full rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm focus:border-accent-500 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500"
          />
          {error && <p className="mt-1 text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
        </div>

        <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={loading}
            className="rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="rounded-md bg-accent-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-accent-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {loading ? 'Restocking…' : 'Restock'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/components/VehicleCard.admin.test.tsx
Content: import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import VehicleCard from './VehicleCard';

vi.mock('../context/AuthContext', () => ({
  useAuth: vi.fn(),
}));
vi.mock('../api/client', () => ({
  purchaseVehicle: vi.fn(),
}));

const mockUseAuth = vi.mocked(useAuth);

const vehicle = (overrides: Partial<Vehicle> = {}): Vehicle => ({
  id: 1,
  make: 'Toyota',
  model: 'Camry',
  category: 'Sedan',
  price: 25000,
  quantity: 2,
  ...overrides,
});

function setAuth(isAdmin: boolean) {
  mockUseAuth.mockReturnValue({
    user: { id: 1, email: 'a@example.com', role: isAdmin ? 'ADMIN' : 'USER' },
    token: 'jwt',
    isAdmin,
    login: vi.fn(),
    register: vi.fn(),
    logout: vi.fn(),
  });
}

describe('VehicleCard admin controls', () => {
  const onPurchased = vi.fn();
  const onError = vi.fn();

  beforeEach(() => {
    mockUseAuth.mockReset();
    onPurchased.mockReset();
    onError.mockReset();
  });

  function renderCard(value: Vehicle) {
    return render(
      <VehicleCard vehicle={value} onPurchased={onPurchased} onError={onError} />,
    );
  }

  it('renders Edit, Restock and Delete buttons for an admin', () => {
    setAuth(true);
    renderCard(vehicle());

    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /edit/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /restock/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /delete/i })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('does not render any admin controls for a regular user', () => {
    setAuth(false);
    renderCard(vehicle());

    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /edit/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /restock/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /delete/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

Content: import { useState } from 'react';
import { purchaseVehicle } from '../api/client';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';

interface VehicleCardProps {
  vehicle: Vehicle;
  onPurchased: (updated: Vehicle) => void;
  onError: () => void;
  onEdit?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onDelete?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onRestock?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
}

const priceFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
  style: 'currency',
  currency: 'USD',
});

/** Deterministic two-color gradient derived from the category string. */
function gradientFor(category: string): string {
  let hash = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < category.length; i += 1) {
    hash = (hash * 31 + category.charCodeAt(i)) % 360;
  }
  const second = (hash + 40) % 360;
  return `linear-gradient(135deg, hsl(${hash} 60% 45%), hsl(${second} 60% 55%))`;
}

/** Upcased initials of the make (first letters of each word). */
function initialsOf(make: string): string {
  return make
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((word) => word.charAt(0))
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase();
}

/** Human-readable stock label. */
function stockLabel(quantity: number): string {
  if (quantity === 0) return 'Out of stock';
  if (quantity <= 3) return `Only ${quantity} left`;
  return `${quantity} in stock`;
}

/**
 * Presents a single vehicle with a gradient header, purchase action and
 * inline status messaging for confirmations and errors. Admins additionally
 * get Edit, Restock and Delete actions.
 */
export default function VehicleCard({
  vehicle,
  onPurchased,
  onError,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onRestock,
}: VehicleCardProps) {
  const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(vehicle);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [confirmed, setConfirmed] = useState(false);

  async function handlePurchase() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    setConfirmed(false);
    try {
      const updated = await purchaseVehicle(current.id);
      setCurrent(updated);
      setConfirmed(true);
      onPurchased(updated);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
      onError();
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const outOfStock = current.quantity === 0;

  return (
    <article className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white shadow-sm">
      <div
        className="flex h-24 items-center justify-center"
        style={{ background: gradientFor(current.category) }}
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <span className="text-2xl font-semibold text-white">{initialsOf(current.make)}</span>
      </div>

      <div className="p-5">
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-3">
          <h3 className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">
            {current.make} {current.model}
          </h3>
          <span className="rounded-full bg-slate-100 px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium text-slate-700">
            {current.category}
          </span>
        </div>

        <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-500">{priceFormatter.format(current.price)}</p>

        <p
          className={`mt-3 inline-block rounded-full px-2.5 py-1 text-xs font-medium ${
            outOfStock ? 'bg-red-100 text-red-700' : 'bg-emerald-100 text-emerald-700'
          }`}
        >
          {stockLabel(current.quantity)}
        </p>

        {isAdmin && (
          <div className="mt-4 flex gap-2">
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onEdit?.(current)}
              aria-label={`Edit ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
              className="flex-1 rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500"
            >
              Edit
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onRestock?.(current)}
              aria-label={`Restock ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
              className="flex-1 rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500"
            >
              Restock
            </button>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => onDelete?.(current)}
              aria-label={`Delete ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
              className="flex-1 rounded-md border border-red-300 px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-red-600 transition-colors hover:bg-red-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-red-500"
            >
              Delete
            </button>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-4">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={handlePurchase}
            disabled={outOfStock || loading}
            aria-label={`Purchase ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
            className="w-full rounded-md bg-accent-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-accent-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500 focus:ring-offset-2 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {loading ? 'Purchasing…' : 'Purchase'}
          </button>
        </div>

        <div aria-live="polite" className="mt-3 min-h-[1.25rem]">
          {confirmed && <p className="text-sm text-emerald-700">Purchase confirmed</p>}
          {error && <p className="text-sm text-red-600">{error}</p>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

Content: import { render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';
import {
  createVehicle,
  deleteVehicle,
  getVehicles,
  restockVehicle,
  searchVehicles,
} from '../api/client';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import DashboardPage from './DashboardPage';

vi.mock('../api/client', () => ({
  getVehicles: vi.fn(),
  searchVehicles: vi.fn(),
  purchaseVehicle: vi.fn(),
  createVehicle: vi.fn(),
  updateVehicle: vi.fn(),
  deleteVehicle: vi.fn(),
  restockVehicle: vi.fn(),
}));
vi.mock('../context/AuthContext', () => ({
  useAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

const mockUseAuth = vi.mocked(useAuth);

const vehicle = (id: number, overrides: Partial<Vehicle> = {}): Vehicle => ({
  id,
  make: 'Toyota',
  model: `Model ${id}`,
  category: 'Sedan',
  price: 20000 + id,
  quantity: 2,
  ...overrides,
});

function setAuth(isAdmin: boolean) {
  mockUseAuth.mockReturnValue({
    user: { id: 1, email: 'a@example.com', role: isAdmin ? 'ADMIN' : 'USER' },
    token: 'jwt',
    isAdmin,
    login: vi.fn(),
    register: vi.fn(),
    logout: vi.fn(),
  });
}

describe('DashboardPage', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    vi.mocked(getVehicles).mockReset();
    vi.mocked(searchVehicles).mockReset();
    vi.mocked(createVehicle).mockReset();
    vi.mocked(deleteVehicle).mockReset();
    vi.mocked(restockVehicle).mockReset();
    setAuth(false);
  });

  it('renders vehicles with a result count', async () => {
    vi.mocked(getVehicles).mockResolvedValue([vehicle(1), vehicle(2)]);

    render(<DashboardPage />);

    expect(screen.getByRole('heading', { name: 'Available vehicles' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(await screen.findByText('Toyota Model 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Toyota Model 2')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('2 vehicles')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('shows the empty state with a clear filters action', async () => {
    vi.mocked(getVehicles).mockResolvedValue([]);

    render(<DashboardPage />);

    expect(await screen.findByText('No vehicles match your filters')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Clear filters' })).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('shows an error state with a retry that reloads', async () => {
    vi.mocked(getVehicles)
      .mockRejectedValueOnce(new Error('Network error'))
      .mockResolvedValueOnce([vehicle(1)]);

    render(<DashboardPage />);

    expect(await screen.findByText(/network error/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /retry/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('Toyota Model 1')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('calls the search endpoint when filters are applied', async () => {
    vi.mocked(getVehicles).mockResolvedValue([vehicle(1), vehicle(2)]);
    vi.mocked(searchVehicles).mockResolvedValue([vehicle(1)]);

    render(<DashboardPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Toyota Model 1');

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/make/i), 'Toy');

    await waitFor(() => expect(searchVehicles).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ make: 'Toy' }));
  });

  it('does not render the Add vehicle button or card admin controls for a USER', async () => {
    setAuth(false);
    vi.mocked(getVehicles).mockResolvedValue([vehicle(1)]);

    render(<DashboardPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Toyota Model 1');

    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /add vehicle/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /edit toyota/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /restock toyota/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /delete toyota/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('adds a vehicle and shows an aria-live confirmation', async () => {
    setAuth(true);
    vi.mocked(getVehicles)
      .mockResolvedValueOnce([vehicle(1)])
      .mockResolvedValueOnce([vehicle(1), vehicle(2, { make: 'Honda', model: 'Civic' })]);
    const created = vehicle(2, { make: 'Honda', model: 'Civic' });
    vi.mocked(createVehicle).mockResolvedValue(created);

    render(<DashboardPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Toyota Model 1');

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /add vehicle/i }));

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/make/i), 'Honda');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/model/i), 'Civic');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/category/i), 'Sedan');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/price/i), '22000');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/quantity/i), '3');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /add vehicle/i }));

    await waitFor(() =>
      expect(createVehicle).toHaveBeenCalledWith({
        make: 'Honda',
        model: 'Civic',
        category: 'Sedan',
        price: 22000,
        quantity: 3,
      }),
    );
    expect(await screen.findByText('Honda Civic')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Honda Civic added')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('deletes a vehicle and removes its card', async () => {
    setAuth(true);
    vi.mocked(getVehicles)
      .mockResolvedValueOnce([vehicle(1)])
      .mockResolvedValueOnce([]);
    vi.mocked(deleteVehicle).mockResolvedValue(undefined);

    render(<DashboardPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Toyota Model 1');

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /delete toyota model 1/i }));
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Delete' }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(deleteVehicle).toHaveBeenCalledWith(1));
    expect(await screen.findByText('Toyota Model 1 deleted')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('Toyota Model 1')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('restocks a vehicle and updates its stock', async () => {
    setAuth(true);
    vi.mocked(getVehicles).mockResolvedValue([vehicle(1)]);
    const restocked = vehicle(1, { quantity: 6 });
    vi.mocked(restockVehicle).mockResolvedValue(restocked);

    render(<DashboardPage />);
    await screen.findByText('Toyota Model 1');

    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /restock toyota model 1/i }));
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/quantity/i), '4');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /restock/i }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(restockVehicle).toHaveBeenCalledWith(1, 4));
    expect(await screen.findByText('6 in stock')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText('Toyota Model 1 restocked')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

Path: frontend/src/components/VehicleGrid.tsx
Content: import type { Vehicle } from '../types';
import VehicleCard from './VehicleCard';

interface VehicleGridProps {
  vehicles: Vehicle[];
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  onClearFilters: () => void;
  onRetry: () => void;
  onPurchased: (updated: Vehicle) => void;
  onError: () => void;
  onEdit?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onDelete?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onRestock?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
}

/**
 * Responsive grid of vehicle cards with loading skeletons, an empty state
 * and an error state with retry.
 */
export default function VehicleGrid({
  vehicles,
  loading,
  error,
  onClearFilters,
  onRetry,
  onPurchased,
  onError,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onRestock,
}: VehicleGridProps) {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
        {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, index) => (
          <div
            key={index}
            className="h-64 animate-pulse rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-slate-100"
            aria-hidden="true"
          />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-8 text-center">
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-600">Something went wrong: {error}</p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRetry}
          className="mt-4 rounded-md bg-accent-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-accent-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500 focus:ring-offset-2"
        >
          Retry
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (vehicles.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-8 text-center">
        <p className="text-lg font-medium text-slate-900">No vehicles match your filters</p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClearFilters}
          className="mt-4 rounded-md border border-slate-300 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-700 transition-colors hover:bg-slate-100 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500"
        >
          Clear filters
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
      {vehicles.map((vehicle) => (
        <VehicleCard
          key={vehicle.id}
          vehicle={vehicle}
          onPurchased={onPurchased}
          onError={onError}
          onEdit={onEdit}
          onDelete={onDelete}
          onRestock={onRestock}
        />
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx
Content: import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import {
  createVehicle,
  deleteVehicle,
  restockVehicle,
  updateVehicle,
  type CreateVehicleInput,
  type UpdateVehicleInput,
} from '../api/client';
import ConfirmDeleteModal from '../components/ConfirmDeleteModal';
import RestockModal from '../components/RestockModal';
import VehicleFilters from '../components/VehicleFilters';
import VehicleFormModal from '../components/VehicleFormModal';
import VehicleGrid from '../components/VehicleGrid';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useVehicles } from '../hooks/useVehicles';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';

type ModalState =
  | { type: 'add' }
  | { type: 'edit'; vehicle: Vehicle }
  | { type: 'delete'; vehicle: Vehicle }
  | { type: 'restock'; vehicle: Vehicle }
  | null;

/**
 * Inventory dashboard: header with result count, filters and the vehicle grid.
 * Admins can add, edit, restock and delete vehicles through modals.
 */
export default function DashboardPage() {
  const { vehicles, loading, error, applyFilters, refresh, replaceVehicle } = useVehicles();
  const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
  const [modal, setModal] = useState<ModalState>(null);
  const [confirmation, setConfirmation] = useState<string | null>(null);

  const categories = useMemo(
    () => Array.from(new Set(vehicles.map((vehicle) => vehicle.category))).sort(),
    [vehicles],
  );

  function clearFilters() {
    void applyFilters({});
  }

  function notify(message: string) {
    setConfirmation(message);
  }

  async function handleAdd(data: CreateVehicleInput | UpdateVehicleInput) {
    await createVehicle(data as CreateVehicleInput);
    setModal(null);
    notify(`${data.make} ${data.model} added`);
    await refresh();
  }

  async function handleEdit(vehicle: Vehicle, data: CreateVehicleInput | UpdateVehicleInput) {
    const updated = await updateVehicle(vehicle.id, data as UpdateVehicleInput);
    replaceVehicle(updated);
    setModal(null);
    notify(`${updated.make} ${updated.model} updated`);
  }

  async function handleDelete(vehicle: Vehicle) {
    await deleteVehicle(vehicle.id);
    setModal(null);
    notify(`${vehicle.make} ${vehicle.model} deleted`);
    await refresh();
  }

  async function handleRestock(vehicle: Vehicle, quantity: number) {
    const updated = await restockVehicle(vehicle.id, quantity);
    replaceVehicle(updated);
    setModal(null);
    notify(`${updated.make} ${updated.model} restocked`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-10 sm:px-6">
      <header className="flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-2">
        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-baseline gap-2">
          <h1 className="text-2xl font-semibold text-slate-900">Available vehicles</h1>
          <p className="text-sm text-slate-500">
            {vehicles.length} {vehicles.length === 1 ? 'vehicle' : 'vehicles'}
          </p>
        </div>
        {isAdmin && (
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => setModal({ type: 'add' })}
            className="rounded-md bg-accent-600 px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white transition-colors hover:bg-accent-700 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-accent-500 focus:ring-offset-2"
          >
            Add vehicle
          </button>
        )}
      </header>

      <div aria-live="polite" className="mt-2 min-h-[1.25rem]">
        {confirmation && <p className="text-sm text-emerald-700">{confirmation}</p>}
      </div>

      <div className="mt-4">
        <VehicleFilters categories={categories} onApply={(filters) => void applyFilters(filters)} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8">
        <VehicleGrid
          vehicles={vehicles}
          loading={loading}
          error={error}
          onClearFilters={clearFilters}
          onRetry={() => void refresh()}
          onPurchased={replaceVehicle}
          onError={() => void refresh()}
          onEdit={isAdmin ? (vehicle) => setModal({ type: 'edit', vehicle }) : undefined}
          onDelete={isAdmin ? (vehicle) => setModal({ type: 'delete', vehicle }) : undefined}
          onRestock={isAdmin ? (vehicle) => setModal({ type: 'restock', vehicle }) : undefined}
        />
      </div>

      {modal?.type === 'add' && (
        <VehicleFormModal
          mode="add"
          initialVehicle={null}
          categories={categories}
          onSubmit={handleAdd}
          onClose={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}

      {modal?.type === 'edit' && (
        <VehicleFormModal
          mode="edit"
          initialVehicle={modal.vehicle}
          categories={categories}
          onSubmit={(data) => handleEdit(modal.vehicle, data)}
          onClose={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}

      {modal?.type === 'delete' && (
        <ConfirmDeleteModal
          vehicleName={`${modal.vehicle.make} ${modal.vehicle.model}`}
          onConfirm={() => handleDelete(modal.vehicle)}
          onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}

      {modal?.type === 'restock' && (
        <RestockModal
          vehicleName={`${modal.vehicle.make} ${modal.vehicle.model}`}
          currentStock={modal.vehicle.quantity}
          onSubmit={(quantity) => handleRestock(modal.vehicle, quantity)}
          onClose={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

Content: import { render, screen } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { MemoryRouter } from 'react-router-dom';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import type { User } from '../types';
import Navbar from './Navbar';

vi.mock('../context/AuthContext', () => ({
  useAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';

const mockUseAuth = vi.mocked(useAuth);

const logout = vi.fn();

function setAuth(token: string | null, user: User | null) {
  mockUseAuth.mockReturnValue({
    user,
    token,
    isAdmin: user?.role === 'ADMIN',
    login: vi.fn(),
    register: vi.fn(),
    logout,
  });
}

describe('Navbar', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    mockUseAuth.mockReset();
    logout.mockReset();
  });

  it('shows the app name', () => {
    setAuth(null, null);
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <Navbar />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );

    expect(screen.getByText('Car Dealership')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('shows the user email and a logout button when logged in', async () => {
    setAuth('jwt', { id: 1, email: 'a@example.com', role: 'USER' });
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <Navbar />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );

    expect(screen.getByText('a@example.com')).toBeInTheDocument();
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Logout' }));
    expect(logout).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
  });

  it('shows a slate "User" badge for a regular user', () => {
    setAuth('jwt', { id: 1, email: 'a@example.com', role: 'USER' });
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <Navbar />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );

    const badge = screen.getByText('User');
    expect(badge).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(badge.className).toContain('bg-slate-100');
    expect(badge.className).toContain('text-slate-700');
  });

  it('shows an accent "Admin" badge for an admin', () => {
    setAuth('jwt', { id: 1, email: 'a@example.com', role: 'ADMIN' });
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <Navbar />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );

    const badge = screen.getByText('Admin');
    expect(badge).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(badge.className).toContain('bg-accent-100');
    expect(badge.className).toContain('text-accent-700');
  });

  it('does not show a role badge when logged out', () => {
    setAuth(null, null);
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <Navbar />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );

    expect(screen.queryByText('Admin')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByText('User')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('shows login and register links when logged out', () => {
    setAuth(null, null);
    render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <Navbar />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );

    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Login' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByRole('link', { name: 'Register' })).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: 'Logout' })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

Result: I implemented the admin UI in `/frontend`, strictly test-first (red → green) for each unit, and left `/backend` untouched.

## What changed

**API client** — [`src/api/client.ts`](frontend/src/api/client.ts)
- Added `CreateVehicleInput` and `UpdateVehicleInput` types plus `createVehicle(data)`, `updateVehicle(id, data)`, `deleteVehicle(id)`, and `restockVehicle(id, quantity)`, all typed against the existing `Vehicle` type and following the existing `request` wrapper (bearer token, `{ error: { message } }` extraction, 204 handling).

**New components**
- [`src/components/Modal.tsx`](frontend/src/components/Modal.tsx) — accessible shell: `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal`, `aria-labelledby`, Escape + backdrop close, focus trap (Tab/Shift+Tab wrapping), initial focus into the dialog, and focus return to the trigger on unmount.
- [`src/components/VehicleFormModal.tsx`](frontend/src/components/VehicleFormModal.tsx) — one form for add/edit with make/model/category (datalist suggestions), price, quantity; client-side validation mirroring the backend messages; inline errors; loading state; server error inside the modal. Edit mode submits only changed fields.
- [`src/components/ConfirmDeleteModal.tsx`](frontend/src/components/ConfirmDeleteModal.tsx) — names the vehicle, Cancel/Delete (destructive red), loading and server error.
- [`src/components/RestockModal.tsx`](frontend/src/components/RestockModal.tsx) — quantity input (positive integer), current stock display, validation and server error.

**Admin controls & dashboard flow**
- [`src/components/VehicleCard.tsx`](frontend/src/components/VehicleCard.tsx) — Edit/Restock/Delete buttons rendered only when `useAuth().isAdmin`; added `onEdit`/`onDelete`/`onRestock` callbacks and a sync effect so parent replacements (restock/edit) reflect on the card.
- [`src/components/VehicleGrid.tsx`](frontend/src/components/VehicleGrid.tsx) — forwards the admin callbacks.
- [`src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx`](frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.tsx) — admin-only "Add vehicle" header button; add/edit/delete/restock modal orchestration; `replaceVehicle` for update/restock and `refresh` for create/delete; aria-live confirmation messages ("Honda Civic added", "… deleted", "… restocked", "… updated"). 403/401 surface via the existing error paths and global 401 handler.
- [`src/components/Navbar.tsx`](frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx) — role badge next to the email ("Admin" in accent, "User" in slate) driven by `useAuth().user.role`.

**Tests** — Vitest + RTL with the api module mocked (no real network):
- `Modal` (Escape/backdrop/focus handling), `VehicleFormModal` (validation, add payload, edit-changed-only, server error), `ConfirmDeleteModal`, `RestockModal` (rejects 0/negative/decimal), `VehicleCard` admin vs user visibility, `DashboardPage` (add/delete/restock + no admin controls for USER), and updated `Navbar` tests for both badges.

## Verification results

- `npm test` → 16 files, **91 tests passed**
- `npm run build` → `tsc && vite build` succeeded
- `npm run lint` → `eslint .` clean (no output)

No dev server was left running and no git commit was performed.


## prompts-log/11-design-overhaul.md

**User:**

<user_message>
Redesign the visual design of the whole /frontend app. This is a design pass only: do NOT change behaviour, routes, API calls or anything under /backend.

Rules for tests: all existing tests must keep passing. Where a test asserts on text or markup that the redesign legitimately changes, update only that assertion, and list every such change in your final summary. Never delete or weaken a test.

Design direction: a premium dark "car showroom" feel.
- Palette: near-black navy background (around #0B1020), raised surfaces slightly lighter with a 1px subtle border and soft shadow, light text (high contrast, WCAG AA), a single warm accent (amber/orange gradient) for primary actions and highlights, green for in-stock, amber for low stock, red for out of stock/destructive. Define these as Tailwind theme extensions (colors, shadows, radii) in tailwind.config.js rather than scattering hex values.
- Typography: install @fontsource-variable/inter for body text and @fontsource/sora (weights 600 and 700) for headings and prices; import them in main.tsx. Clear hierarchy, tabular numbers for prices.
- Icons: install lucide-react and use it for the logo mark, search, filters, stock, edit, restock, delete, logout and similar. Use no other new dependencies.

Components and pages:
1. Navbar: sticky, translucent blur, logo mark plus wordmark, role badge (Admin / User) next to the email, logout button, a working mobile menu.
2. Auth pages (login and register): split layout. On large screens a brand panel on the left (headline, short value proposition, a decorative gradient and inline-SVG car silhouette) and the form on the right; on mobile only the form. Inputs with leading icons, show/hide password toggle, clear focus rings, a polished primary button with its loading spinner.
3. Dashboard: a hero banner with a headline, a one-line subtitle and a stats strip (total vehicles, in stock, categories) computed from the loaded data. Below it a sticky filter bar with category chips (All plus each category), the text and price inputs, and a Clear button.
4. Vehicle card: replace the plain gradient header with an inline-SVG illustration per category (sedan, SUV, hatchback, truck, coupe, electric; a generic fallback) on a category-tinted gradient, with the make initials subtly in the background. Big price in the heading font, model as the title, make as an eyebrow label, a stock indicator with a small progress bar and colored label, a full-width gradient Purchase button (clear disabled state for out of stock). Admin buttons appear as a compact icon row only for admins. Hover: gentle lift and glow.
5. Modals: matching dark surfaces, backdrop blur, smooth fade and scale entrance.
6. Feedback: replace inline confirmations with a toast system (bottom-right on desktop, top on mobile, auto-dismiss, aria-live polite, dismissible). Keep error messages inside the relevant component too.
7. States: shimmer skeleton cards, an illustrated empty state, a friendly error state with Retry.
8. Motion: subtle and fast (150 to 250 ms), staggered card fade-in on load, and everything respects prefers-reduced-motion.
9. Responsive from 360px wide up, with no horizontal scrolling. Keyboard focus visible everywhere. Colour is never the only carrier of meaning (stock states also have text).

  4 | interface ModalProps {
  5 |   title: string;
  6 |   onClose: () => void;
  7 |   children: ReactNode;
  8 | }
  9 | 
 10 | /** Selectors for elements that can receive keyboard focus. */
 11 | const FOCUSABLE =
 12 |   'a[href], button:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
 13 | 
 14 | /**
 15 |  * Accessible modal shell rendered in a portal.
 16 |  * Sets aria-modal, closes on Escape and backdrop click, traps focus while
 17 |  * open and restores focus to the previously focused element on close.
 18 |  */
 19 | export default function Modal({ title, onClose, children }: ModalProps) {
 20 |   const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
 21 |   const previouslyFocusedRef = useRef<Element | null>(null);
 22 | 
 23 |   useEffect(() => {
 24 |     previouslyFocusedRef.current = document.activeElement;
 25 | 
 26 |     // Move focus into the dialog on open.
 27 |     const dialog = dialogRef.current;
 28 |     dialog?.focus();
 29 | 
 30 |     return () => {
 31 |       // Restore focus to the trigger on close.
 32 |       if (previouslyFocusedRef.current instanceof HTMLElement) {
 33 |         previouslyFocusedRef.current.focus();
 34 |       }
 35 |     };
 36 |   }, []);
 37 | 
 38 |   useEffect(() => {
 39 |     function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 40 |       if (event.key === 'Escape') {
 41 |         event.preventDefault();
 42 |         onClose();
 43 |         return;
 44 |       }
 45 | 
 46 |       if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
 47 | 
 48 |       const dialog = dialogRef.current;
 49 |       if (!dialog) return;
 50 | 
 51 |       const focusable = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE));
 52 | 
 53 |       if (focusable.length === 0) {
 54 |         event.preventDefault();
 55 |         dialog.focus();
 56 |         return;
 57 |       }
 58 | 
 59 |       const first = focusable[0];
 60 |       const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
 61 | 
 62 |       if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
 63 |         event.preventDefault();
 64 |         last.focus();
 65 |       } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
 66 |         event.preventDefault();
 67 |         first.focus();
 68 |       }
 69 |     }
 70 | 
 71 |     document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
 72 |     return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
 73 |   }, [onClose]);
 74 | 
 75 |   return createPortal(
 76 |     <div
 77 |       className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
 78 |       data-testid="modal-backdrop"
 79 |       onClick={onClose}
 80 |     >
 81 |       <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-slate-900/50" aria-hidden="true" />
 82 |       <div
 83 |         ref={dialogRef}
 84 |         role="dialog"
 85 |         aria-modal="true"
 86 |         aria-labelledby="modal-title"
 87 |         tabIndex={-1}
 88 |         onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
 89 |         className="relative w-full max-w-md rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-6 shadow-lg focus:outline-none"
 90 |       >
 91 |         <h2 id="modal-title" className="text-lg font-semibold text-slate-900">
 92 |           {title}
 93 |         </h2>
 94 |         {children}
 95 |       </div>
 96 |     </div>,
 97 |     document.body,
 98 |   );
 99 | }

245 |   if (price !== initial.price) changes.price = price;

 52 | /**

 54 |  * Persists token and user in localStorage, wrapped in try/catch for safety.

 56 | export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {

 58 |   const [user, setUser] = useState<User | null>(() => readPersistedUser());

 66 |     } catch {

 68 |     }

 87 |   }, []);

20 | /**
21 |  * Loads vehicles and exposes filtering, refreshing and local replacement.
22 |  * Uses the search endpoint only when at least one filter is set and ignores
23 |  * stale responses by tracking the latest request id.
24 |  */
25 | export function useVehicles(): UseVehiclesResult {
26 |   const [vehicles, setVehicles] = useState<Vehicle[]>([]);
27 |   const [loading, setLoading] = useState(true);
28 |   const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
29 |   const filtersRef = useRef<VehicleFilters>({});
30 |   const requestIdRef = useRef(0);
31 | 
32 |   const load = useCallback(async () => {
33 |     const requestId = ++requestIdRef.current;
34 |     const filters = filtersRef.current;
35 |     setLoading(true);
36 |     setError(null);
37 | 
38 |     try {
39 |       const data = hasFilters(filters) ? await searchVehicles(filters) : await getVehicles();
40 |       if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) {
41 |         setVehicles(data);
42 |       }
43 |     } catch (err) {
44 |       if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) {
45 |         setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
46 |       }
47 |     } finally {
48 |       if (requestId === requestIdRef.current) {
49 |         setLoading(false);
50 |       }
51 |     }
52 |   }, []);
53 | 
54 |   useEffect(() => {
55 |     void load();
56 |   }, [load]);
57 | 
58 |   const applyFilters = useCallback(
59 |     async (filters: VehicleFilters) => {
60 |       filtersRef.current = filters;
61 |       await load();
62 |     },
63 |     [load],
64 |   );
65 | 
66 |   const refresh = useCallback(async () => {
67 |     await load();
68 |   }, [load]);
69 | 
70 |   const replaceVehicle = useCallback((updated: Vehicle) => {
71 |     setVehicles((current) =>
72 |       current.map((vehicle) => (vehicle.id === updated.id ? updated : vehicle)),
73 |     );
74 |   }, []);
75 | 
76 |   return { vehicles, loading, error, applyFilters, refresh, replaceVehicle };
77 | }

 38 | /**

 44 | async function request<T>(path: string, options: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
 45 |   const token = getToken();
 46 |   const headers = new Headers(options.headers);
 47 |   headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json');
 48 |   if (token) {
 49 |     headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`);
 50 |   }
 51 | 
 52 |   const response = await fetch(`${BASE_URL}${path}`, { ...options, headers });
 53 | 
 54 |   if (!response.ok) {
 55 |     const body = (await parseBody(response)) as { error?: { message?: string } } | undefined;
 56 |     // Only authenticated requests should trigger the global 401 handler.
 57 |     if (response.status === 401 && token) {
 58 |       unauthorizedHandler?.();
 59 |     }
 60 |     throw new Error(body?.error?.message ?? `Request failed with status ${response.status}`);
 61 |   }
 62 | 
 63 |   return (await parseBody(response)) as T;
 64 | }

 6 | 
 7 | interface HarnessProps {
 8 |   onCloseSpy?: () => void;
 9 | }
10 | 
11 | /** Opens the modal via a trigger button so focus return can be asserted. */
12 | function Harness({ onCloseSpy }: HarnessProps) {
13 |   const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);
14 |   return (
15 |     <div>
16 |       <button type="button" onClick={() => setOpen(true)}>
17 |         Open modal
18 |       </button>
19 |       {open && (
20 |         <Modal
21 |           title="Test dialog"
22 |           onClose={() => {
23 |             setOpen(false);
24 |             onCloseSpy?.();
25 |           }}
26 |         >
27 |           <button type="button">First</button>
28 |           <input aria-label="field" />
29 |           <button type="button">Last</button>
30 |         </Modal>
31 |       )}
32 |     </div>
33 |   );
34 | }
35 | 
36 | describe('Modal', () => {
37 |   it('renders an accessible dialog labelled by its title', async () => {
38 |     render(<Harness />);
39 |     await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }));
40 | 
41 |     const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog', { name: 'Test dialog' });
42 |     expect(dialog).toBeInTheDocument();
43 |     expect(dialog).toHaveAttribute('aria-modal', 'true');
44 |   });
45 | 
46 |   it('closes when Escape is pressed', async () => {
47 |     const onCloseSpy = vi.fn();
48 |     render(<Harness onCloseSpy={onCloseSpy} />);
49 |     await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }));
50 | 
51 |     await userEvent.keyboard('{Escape}');
52 | 
53 |     expect(onCloseSpy).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
54 |     expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
55 |   });
56 | 
57 |   it('closes when the backdrop is clicked but not when the dialog is clicked', async () => {
58 |     const onCloseSpy = vi.fn();
59 |     render(<Harness onCloseSpy={onCloseSpy} />);
60 |     await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }));
61 | 
62 |     // Clicking inside the dialog must not close it.
63 |     await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('dialog'));
64 |     expect(onCloseSpy).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
65 | 
66 |     // Clicking the backdrop must close it.
67 |     await userEvent.click(screen.getByTestId('modal-backdrop'));
68 |     expect(onCloseSpy).toHaveBeenCalledOnce();
69 |     expect(screen.queryByRole('dialog')).not.toBeInTheDocument();
70 |   });
71 | 
72 |   it('moves focus into the dialog when opened and traps Tab within it', async () => {
73 |     render(<Harness />);
74 |     await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Open modal' }));
75 | 
76 |     const dialog = screen.getByRole('dialog');
77 |     expect(dialog).toHaveFocus();
78 | 
79 |     // Focus the last focusable element and Tab forward: focus wraps to first.
80 |     screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Last' }).focus();
81 |     await userEvent.tab();
82 | 
83 |     expect(screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'First' })).toHaveFocus();
84 |   });
85 | 
86 |   it('returns focus to the trigger when closed', async () => {
87 |     render(<Harness />);

89 |     await userEvent.click(trigger);

Actually, `getByText` matches against the *text content* of elements, but by default it only matches elements whose *own* text (the text of the node and its children, considering only direct text nodes?) Let me recall Testing Library's `getByText` behavior.

`getByText` uses `matches` on the element's text content. Specifically, the default matcher checks `element.textContent` for the *element itself*, and importantly it also checks that the text is from a single element — it uses `getNodeText(node)` which concatenates the direct text nodes of `node` only (not descendants). Wait, let me recall precisely.

From Testing Library docs: `getByText` will match the element that directly contains the text. The function `getNodeText(node)` returns the concatenation of `node.textContent` but only for text nodes that are direct children? Actually no.

Let me recall: The `*ByText` queries use `getDefaultNormalizer` and the `matches` function checks `getNodeText(node)`. `getNodeText`:
```js
function getNodeText(node) {
  if (node.matches('input[type=submit], input[type=button]')) {
    return node.value;
  }
  return Array.from(node.childNodes)
    .filter(child => child.nodeType === TEXT_NODE)
    .map(child => child.textContent)
    .join('');
}
```

So `getNodeText` only considers *direct* text node children. So if I have:
```html
<h3>
  <span>Toyota</span>
  <span>Model 1</span>
</h3>
```
The h3's direct text nodes are none (children are spans), so `getNodeText(h3)` returns '' → won't match "Toyota Model 1".

If instead:
```html
<h3>
  Toyota
  <span>Model 1</span>
</h3>
```
Then getNodeText(h3) = "Toyota" (plus maybe whitespace), not "Toyota Model 1".

So no single node would have text "Toyota Model 1".

ToastProvider needs to render the viewport. Let me write it.

```tsx
import { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useMemo, useRef, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { CheckCircle2, X, AlertCircle } from 'lucide-react';

type ToastType = 'success' | 'error';

interface Toast {
  id: number;
  message: string;
  type: ToastType;
}

interface ToastContextValue {
  toast: (message: string, type?: ToastType) => void;
  success: (message: string) => void;
  error: (message: string) => void;
}

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

const AUTO_DISMISS_MS = 4000;

export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id: number) => {
    setToasts((current) => current.filter((t) => t.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const toast = useCallback((message: string, type: ToastType = 'success') => {
    const id = ++idRef.current;
    setToasts((current) => [...current, { id, message, type }]);
    window.setTimeout(() => dismiss(id), AUTO_DISMISS_MS);
  }, [dismiss]);

  const value = useMemo(() => ({
    toast,
    success: (message: string) => toast(message, 'success'),
    error: (message: string) => toast(message, 'error'),
  }), [toast]);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      <div aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="false" className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-4 top-4 z-[60] flex flex-col items-end gap-2 sm:inset-x-auto sm:bottom-4 sm:right-4 sm:top-auto">
        {toasts.map((t) => (
          <div key={t.id} className="pointer-events-auto ...">
            ...
          </div>
        ))}
      </div>
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

export function useToast() { ... }
```

```tsx
  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b border-line bg-ink/80 backdrop-blur-md">
      <nav className="mx-auto flex h-16 max-w-7xl items-center justify-between px-4 sm:px-6">
        <Link to="/" className="flex items-center gap-2.5">
          <span className="logo mark"><Car icon /></span>
          <span className="font-display text-lg font-semibold text-slate-50">Car Dealership</span>
        </Link>

        {/* Desktop */}
        <div className="hidden items-center gap-4 md:flex">
          {user ? (
            <>
              <span className="text-sm text-slate-300">{user.email}</span>
              <RoleBadge role={user.role} />
              <button onClick={logout} className={...}>Logout</button>  // with LogOut icon
            </>
          ) : (
            <>
              <Link to="/login">Login</Link>
              <Link to="/register">Register</Link>
            </>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Mobile hamburger */}
        <button className="md:hidden" aria-label="Open menu" onClick={() => setMenuOpen(v=>!v)}>
          <Menu />
        </button>
      </nav>

      {/* Mobile menu */}
      {menuOpen && (
        <div className="md:hidden border-t border-line px-4 py-3">
          {user ? (
            <div>
              <span>{user.email}</span>
              <RoleBadge/>
              <button onClick={()=>{logout(); setMenuOpen(false);}}>Logout</button>
            </div>
          ) : (
            <div>
              <Link to="/login" onClick={close}>Login</Link>
              <Link to="/register" onClick={close}>Register</Link>
            </div>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}
```

Content: @tailwind base;
@tailwind components;
@tailwind utilities;

@layer base {
  :root {
    color-scheme: dark;
  }

  html {
    scroll-behavior: smooth;
  }

  body {
    @apply bg-canvas font-sans text-slate-200 antialiased;
  }

  /* Consistent, always-visible keyboard focus. */
  :focus-visible {
    @apply outline-none ring-2 ring-accent-400 ring-offset-2 ring-offset-canvas;
  }

  ::selection {
    @apply bg-accent-500/40 text-white;
  }

  /* Tabular numbers for prices and any numeric data. */
  .tabular-nums {
    font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
  }
}

@layer utilities {
  .text-gradient-accent {
    @apply bg-gradient-to-r from-accent-300 via-accent-400 to-accent-600 bg-clip-text text-transparent;
  }

  .bg-gradient-accent {
    @apply bg-gradient-to-r from-accent-500 to-accent-700;
  }

  .no-scrollbar::-webkit-scrollbar {
    display: none;
  }
  .no-scrollbar {
    -ms-overflow-style: none;
    scrollbar-width: none;
  }

  .animate-card {
    animation: fade-in 250ms ease-out both;
  }
}

@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  html {
    scroll-behavior: auto;
  }

  *,
  *::before,
  *::after {
    animation-duration: 0.001ms !important;
    animation-iteration-count: 1 !important;
    transition-duration: 0.001ms !important;
  }
}

[Tool Use: write_to_file]
Path: frontend/src/context/ToastContext.tsx
Content: import {
  createContext,
  useCallback,
  useContext,
  useMemo,
  useRef,
  useState,
  type ReactNode,
} from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { CheckCircle2, X, XCircle } from 'lucide-react';

type ToastTone = 'success' | 'error';

interface Toast {
  id: number;
  message: string;
  tone: ToastTone;
}

interface ToastContextValue {
  toast: (message: string, tone?: ToastTone) => void;
}

const ToastContext = createContext<ToastContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

const AUTO_DISMISS_MS = 4000;

/**
 * Provides a lightweight toast system. Toasts stack in the bottom-right on
 * desktop and across the top on mobile, auto-dismiss and can be dismissed.
 */
export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);
  const idRef = useRef(0);

  const dismiss = useCallback((id: number) => {
    setToasts((current) => current.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id));
  }, []);

  const toast = useCallback(
    (message: string, tone: ToastTone = 'success') => {
      const id = ++idRef.current;
      setToasts((current) => [...current, { id, message, tone }]);
      window.setTimeout(() => dismiss(id), AUTO_DISMISS_MS);
    },
    [dismiss],
  );

  const value = useMemo<ToastContextValue>(() => ({ toast }), [toast]);

  return (
    <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
      {children}
      {createPortal(
        <div
          aria-live="polite"
          aria-label="Notifications"
          className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-[60] flex flex-col items-center gap-2 px-4 pt-4 sm:inset-x-auto sm:bottom-4 sm:right-4 sm:top-auto sm:items-end sm:px-0 sm:pt-0"
        >
          {toasts.map((item) => (
            <div
              key={item.id}
              role="status"
              className="pointer-events-auto flex w-full max-w-sm items-start gap-3 rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface-raised px-4 py-3 shadow-modal animate-toast-in"
            >
              {item.tone === 'success' ? (
                <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-ok" aria-hidden="true" />
              ) : (
                <XCircle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-danger" aria-hidden="true" />
              )}
              <p className="flex-1 text-sm text-slate-100">{item.message}</p>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => dismiss(item.id)}
                aria-label="Dismiss notification"
                className="rounded-md p-1 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-200 hover:text-slate-100"
              >
                <X className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>,
        document.body,
      )}
    </ToastContext.Provider>
  );
}

/** Hook to show toasts; must be used within a ToastProvider. */
// eslint-disable-next-line react-refresh/only-export-components
export function useToast(): ToastContextValue {
  const context = useContext(ToastContext);
  if (!context) {
    throw new Error('useToast must be used within a ToastProvider');
  }
  return context;
}

interface LogoProps {
  compact?: boolean;
}

/**
 * Brand mark plus wordmark. The mark is a rounded gradient tile with a car
 * icon; the wordmark uses the display font.
 */
export default function Logo({ compact = false }: LogoProps) {
  return (
    <span className="inline-flex items-center gap-2.5">
      <span
        className="flex h-9 w-9 items-center justify-center rounded-xl bg-gradient-accent text-canvas shadow-glow"
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <Car className="h-5 w-5" strokeWidth={2.2} />
      </span>
      {!compact && (
        <span className="font-display text-lg font-semibold tracking-tight text-white">
          Showroom
        </span>
      )}
    </span>
  );
}

/**
 * Left-hand brand panel for the auth split layout. Hidden on small screens,
 * it presents a headline, value proposition and a decorative gradient with a
 * car silhouette.
 */
export default function BrandPanel() {
  return (
    <section
      className="relative hidden overflow-hidden border-r border-line bg-canvas-50 lg:flex lg:flex-col lg:justify-between lg:p-12"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -left-24 top-1/3 h-72 w-72 rounded-full bg-accent-500/20 blur-3xl" />
      <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-16 bottom-0 h-64 w-64 rounded-full bg-accent-700/20 blur-3xl" />

      <div className="relative">
        <Logo />
      </div>

      <div className="relative max-w-md">
        <h2 className="font-display text-3xl font-semibold leading-tight text-white">
          Your inventory, under the lights.
        </h2>
        <p className="mt-4 text-base leading-relaxed text-slate-300">
          Browse, filter and manage every vehicle in one polished showroom — real-time stock,
          clear pricing and controls that stay out of the way.
        </p>
      </div>

      <div className="relative mt-10">
        <div className="rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-gradient-to-br from-surface to-canvas p-8 shadow-card">
          <CarSilhouette />
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/components/Navbar.tsx
Content: import { useState } from 'react';
import { Link } from 'react-router-dom';
import { LogOut, Menu, X } from 'lucide-react';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import Logo from './Logo';

/**
 * Top navigation bar: sticky with a translucent blur. Shows the brand mark and
 * wordmark plus either the logged-in user's email, role badge and logout, or
 * login/register links. A toggle reveals the same actions in a mobile menu.
 */
export default function Navbar() {
  const { user, logout } = useAuth();
  const [open, setOpen] = useState(false);

  return (
    <header className="sticky top-0 z-40 border-b border-line/70 bg-canvas/80 backdrop-blur-md">
      <nav className="mx-auto flex max-w-6xl items-center justify-between gap-4 px-4 py-3 sm:px-6">
        <Link to="/" aria-label="Showroom home" onClick={() => setOpen(false)}>
          <Logo />
        </Link>

        {/* Desktop actions */}
        <div className="hidden items-center gap-4 md:flex">
          {user ? (
            <LoggedInActions user={user} onLogout={logout} />
          ) : (
            <LoggedOutActions />
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Mobile menu toggle */}
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={() => setOpen((current) => !current)}
          aria-expanded={open}
          aria-controls="mobile-nav"
          aria-label="Toggle menu"
          className="rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface p-2 text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:text-white md:hidden"
        >
          {open ? <X className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" /> : <Menu className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" />}
        </button>
      </nav>

      {/* Mobile menu */}
      {open && (
        <div
          id="mobile-nav"
          className="border-t border-line bg-surface px-4 py-4 md:hidden"
        >
          {user ? (
            <div className="space-y-4">
              <LoggedInActions user={user} onLogout={logout} column />
            </div>
          ) : (
            <LoggedOutActions column />
          )}
        </div>
      )}
    </header>
  );
}

interface LoggedInActionsProps {
  user: { email: string; role: 'USER' | 'ADMIN' };
  onLogout: () => void;
  column?: boolean;
}

function LoggedInActions({ user, onLogout, column = false }: LoggedInActionsProps) {
  return (
    <div className={`${column ? 'flex-col' : 'flex-row'} flex items-${column ? 'stretch' : 'center'} gap-4`}>
      <div className={`flex ${column ? 'flex-col' : 'flex-row'} items-${column ? 'stretch' : 'center'} gap-3`}>
        <span className="text-sm text-slate-300">{user.email}</span>
        <span
          className={`rounded-full border px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium ${
            user.role === 'ADMIN'
              ? 'border-accent-500/30 bg-accent-500/15 text-accent-300'
              : 'border-line bg-surface-200 text-slate-300'
          }`}
        >
          {user.role === 'ADMIN' ? 'Admin' : 'User'}
        </span>
      </div>
      <button
        type="button"
        onClick={onLogout}
        className="inline-flex items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface-raised px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-200 transition-colors hover:border-danger/50 hover:text-danger"
      >
        <LogOut className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
        Logout
      </button>
    </div>
  );
}

function LoggedOutActions({ column = false }: { column?: boolean }) {
  return (
    <div className={`flex ${column ? 'flex-col' : 'flex-row'} items-${column ? 'stretch' : 'center'} gap-3`}>
      <Link
        to="/login"
        className="rounded-lg px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-300 transition-colors hover:text-white"
      >
        Login
      </Link>
      <Link
        to="/register"
        className="rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-white shadow-glow transition-transform hover:scale-[1.02]"
      >
        Register
      </Link>
    </div>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.tsx
Content: import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, Navigate, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Eye, EyeOff, Lock, Mail } from 'lucide-react';
import BrandPanel from '../components/BrandPanel';
import Spinner from '../components/Spinner';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { validateEmail, validatePassword } from '../utils/validation';

/**
 * Login page. Split layout with a brand panel on large screens and a form on
 * the right. Client-side validation, password visibility toggle, loading
 * state and server error rendering. Authenticated users redirect to the
 * dashboard, and a successful login replaces /login in history.
 */
export default function LoginPage() {
  const { login, token } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<{ email?: string; password?: string }>({});
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  if (token) {
    return <Navigate to="/" replace />;
  }

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);

    const emailError = validateEmail(email);
    const passwordError = validatePassword(password);
    setFieldErrors({ email: emailError ?? undefined, password: passwordError ?? undefined });

    if (emailError || passwordError) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await login(email.trim(), password);
      navigate('/', { replace: true });
    } catch (error) {
      setServerError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid min-h-screen lg:grid-cols-2">
      <BrandPanel />

      <div className="flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-12 sm:px-8">
        <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold text-white">Log in</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-400">Welcome back to the dealership inventory.</p>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mt-8 space-y-5" noValidate>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                Email
              </label>
              <div className="relative mt-1.5">
                <Mail
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                <input
                  id="email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="you@example.com"
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface py-2.5 pl-10 pr-3 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500"
                />
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.email && (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.email}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                Password
              </label>
              <div className="relative mt-1.5">
                <Lock
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                <input
                  id="password"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  autoComplete="current-password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface py-2.5 pl-10 pr-11 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500"
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword((current) => !current)}
                  aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
                  className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1.5 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:text-slate-200"
                >
                  {showPassword ? (
                    <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  ) : (
                    <Eye className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.password && (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.password}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            {serverError && (
              <p className="rounded-lg border border-danger/40 bg-danger-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm text-danger">
                {serverError}
              </p>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {loading && <Spinner />}
              {loading ? 'Logging in…' : 'Log in'}
            </button>
          </form>

          <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-slate-400">
            Don't have an account?{' '}
            <Link to="/register" className="font-medium text-accent-400 hover:text-accent-300">
              Register
            </Link>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/pages/RegisterPage.tsx
Content: import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { Link, Navigate, useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom';
import { Eye, EyeOff, Lock, Mail } from 'lucide-react';
import BrandPanel from '../components/BrandPanel';
import Spinner from '../components/Spinner';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { validateEmail, validatePassword } from '../utils/validation';

/**
 * Registration page. Split layout with a brand panel on large screens and the
 * form on the right. Validates email, password length and confirmation, then
 * creates the account and redirects to /login (registering does not log in).
 * Authenticated users are redirected straight to the dashboard.
 */
export default function RegisterPage() {
  const { register, token } = useAuth();
  const navigate = useNavigate();
  const [email, setEmail] = useState('');
  const [password, setPassword] = useState('');
  const [confirmPassword, setConfirmPassword] = useState('');
  const [showPassword, setShowPassword] = useState(false);
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<{
    email?: string;
    password?: string;
    confirmPassword?: string;
  }>({});
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  if (token) {
    return <Navigate to="/" replace />;
  }

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);

    const emailError = validateEmail(email);
    const passwordError = validatePassword(password);
    const confirmPasswordError =
      password !== confirmPassword ? 'Passwords do not match' : undefined;

    setFieldErrors({
      email: emailError ?? undefined,
      password: passwordError ?? undefined,
      confirmPassword: confirmPasswordError,
    });

    if (emailError || passwordError || confirmPasswordError) {
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await register(email.trim(), password);
      navigate('/login');
    } catch (error) {
      setServerError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const inputClass =
    'w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface py-2.5 pl-10 pr-11 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500';

  return (
    <div className="grid min-h-screen lg:grid-cols-2">
      <BrandPanel />

      <div className="flex items-center justify-center px-4 py-12 sm:px-8">
        <div className="w-full max-w-sm">
          <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold text-white">Create an account</h1>
          <p className="mt-2 text-sm text-slate-400">Register to manage the dealership inventory.</p>

          <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} className="mt-8 space-y-5" noValidate>
            <div>
              <label htmlFor="email" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                Email
              </label>
              <div className="relative mt-1.5">
                <Mail
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                <input
                  id="email"
                  type="email"
                  autoComplete="email"
                  value={email}
                  onChange={(event) => setEmail(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="you@example.com"
                  className="w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface py-2.5 pl-10 pr-3 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500"
                />
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.email && (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.email}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="password" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                Password
              </label>
              <div className="relative mt-1.5">
                <Lock
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                <input
                  id="password"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  autoComplete="new-password"
                  value={password}
                  onChange={(event) => setPassword(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  className={inputClass}
                />
                <button
                  type="button"
                  onClick={() => setShowPassword((current) => !current)}
                  aria-label={showPassword ? 'Hide password' : 'Show password'}
                  className="absolute right-2 top-1/2 -translate-y-1/2 rounded-md p-1.5 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:text-slate-200"
                >
                  {showPassword ? (
                    <EyeOff className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  ) : (
                    <Eye className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
                  )}
                </button>
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.password && (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.password}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            <div>
              <label htmlFor="confirmPassword" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
                Confirm password
              </label>
              <div className="relative mt-1.5">
                <Lock
                  className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                  aria-hidden="true"
                />
                <input
                  id="confirmPassword"
                  type={showPassword ? 'text' : 'password'}
                  autoComplete="new-password"
                  value={confirmPassword}
                  onChange={(event) => setConfirmPassword(event.target.value)}
                  placeholder="••••••••"
                  className={inputClass}
                />
              </div>
              {fieldErrors.confirmPassword && (
                <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.confirmPassword}</p>
              )}
            </div>

            {serverError && (
              <p className="rounded-lg border border-danger/40 bg-danger-muted px-3 py-2 text-sm text-danger">
                {serverError}
              </p>
            )}

            <button
              type="submit"
              disabled={loading}
              className="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
            >
              {loading && <Spinner />}
              {loading ? 'Registering…' : 'Register'}
            </button>
          </form>

          <p className="mt-6 text-sm text-slate-400">
            Already have an account?{' '}
            <Link to="/login" className="font-medium text-accent-400 hover:text-accent-300">
              Log in
            </Link>
          </p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}
