Content: import { Navigate, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom';
import Navbar from './components/Navbar';
import ProtectedRoute from './components/ProtectedRoute';
import { ToastProvider } from './context/ToastContext';
import DashboardPage from './pages/DashboardPage';
import LoginPage from './pages/LoginPage';
import RegisterPage from './pages/RegisterPage';

/** Top-level application routes. */
export default function App() {
  return (
    <ToastProvider>
      <div className="min-h-screen bg-canvas">
        <Navbar />
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
          <Route path="/register" element={<RegisterPage />} />
          <Route
            path="/"
            element={
              <ProtectedRoute>
                <DashboardPage />
              </ProtectedRoute>
            }
          />
          <Route path="*" element={<Navigate to="/" replace />} />
        </Routes>
      </div>
    </ToastProvider>
  );
}

Content: import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';
import { Search, SlidersHorizontal, X } from 'lucide-react';
import type { VehicleFilters as FilterValues } from '../types';

interface VehicleFiltersProps {
  categories: string[];
  onApply: (filters: FilterValues) => void;
}

const EMPTY_FILTERS: FilterValues = {};

/** Reads a numeric price input, returning undefined for blank or NaN values. */
function toNumber(value: string): number | undefined {
  if (value === '') return undefined;
  const parsed = Number(value);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? undefined : parsed;
}

/**
 * Inventory filter controls rendered as a sticky bar. Category chips (All plus
 * each category) apply immediately; text inputs are debounced by 300ms; price
 * inputs apply immediately but block (with an inline message) when min > max.
 */
export default function VehicleFilters({ categories, onApply }: VehicleFiltersProps) {
  const [make, setMake] = useState('');
  const [model, setModel] = useState('');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState('');
  const [minPrice, setMinPrice] = useState('');
  const [maxPrice, setMaxPrice] = useState('');
  const [priceError, setPriceError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const debounceRef = useRef<ReturnType<typeof setTimeout> | null>(null);

  function applyFilters(next: FilterValues) {
    onApply(next);
  }

  function clear() {
    setMake('');
    setModel('');
    setCategory('');
    setMinPrice('');
    setMaxPrice('');
    setPriceError(null);
    applyFilters(EMPTY_FILTERS);
  }

  function applyPriceFilters(nextMin: string, nextMax: string) {
    const min = toNumber(nextMin);
    const max = toNumber(nextMax);
    if (min !== undefined && max !== undefined && min > max) {
      setPriceError('Min price must not be greater than max price');
      return;
    }
    setPriceError(null);
    applyFilters({
      make: make || undefined,
      model: model || undefined,
      category: category || undefined,
      minPrice: min,
      maxPrice: max,
    });
  }

  // Debounce text inputs so a request is only fired after typing stops.
  useEffect(() => {
    if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    debounceRef.current = setTimeout(() => {
      applyFilters({
        make: make || undefined,
        model: model || undefined,
        category: category || undefined,
        minPrice: toNumber(minPrice),
        maxPrice: toNumber(maxPrice),
      });
    }, 300);

    return () => {
      if (debounceRef.current) clearTimeout(debounceRef.current);
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
  }, [make, model, category]);

  const inputClass =
    'w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface py-2 pl-9 pr-3 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500';

  return (
    <div className="sticky top-16 z-30 rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface/90 shadow-card backdrop-blur-md">
      <div className="flex items-center gap-2 border-b border-line px-4 py-3">
        <SlidersHorizontal className="h-4 w-4 text-accent-400" aria-hidden="true" />
        <span className="text-sm font-medium text-slate-200">Filters</span>
      </div>

      <div className="space-y-4 p-4">
        {/* Category chips */}
        <fieldset>
          <legend className="mb-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">Category</legend>
          <div className="flex flex-wrap gap-2">
            <CategoryChip active={category === ''} onClick={() => setCategory('')} label="All" />
            {categories.map((option) => (
              <CategoryChip
                key={option}
                active={category === option}
                onClick={() => setCategory(option)}
                label={option}
              />
            ))}
          </div>
        </fieldset>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-4 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="make" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
              Make
            </label>
            <div className="relative mt-1.5">
              <Search
                className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
              <input
                id="make"
                type="text"
                value={make}
                onChange={(event) => setMake(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Toyota"
                className={inputClass}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="model" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
              Model
            </label>
            <div className="relative mt-1.5">
              <Search
                className="pointer-events-none absolute left-3 top-1/2 h-4 w-4 -translate-y-1/2 text-slate-500"
                aria-hidden="true"
              />
              <input
                id="model"
                type="text"
                value={model}
                onChange={(event) => setModel(event.target.value)}
                placeholder="e.g. Corolla"
                className={inputClass}
              />
            </div>
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="minPrice" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
              Min price
            </label>
            <input
              id="minPrice"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              value={minPrice}
              onChange={(event) => {
                const next = event.target.value;
                setMinPrice(next);
                applyPriceFilters(next, maxPrice);
              }}
              placeholder="0"
              className={`mt-1.5 ${inputClass}`}
            />
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="maxPrice" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
              Max price
            </label>
            <input
              id="maxPrice"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              value={maxPrice}
              onChange={(event) => {
                const next = event.target.value;
                setMaxPrice(next);
                applyPriceFilters(minPrice, next);
              }}
              placeholder="Any"
              className={`mt-1.5 ${inputClass}`}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        <div className="flex flex-wrap items-center gap-4">
          {priceError && (
            <p className="text-sm text-danger" role="alert">
              {priceError}
            </p>
          )}
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={clear}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-1.5 rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface-raised px-3 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-200 transition-colors hover:border-danger/50 hover:text-danger"
          >
            <X className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            Clear
          </button>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

interface CategoryChipProps {
  label: string;
  active: boolean;
  onClick: () => void;
}

function CategoryChip({ label, active, onClick }: CategoryChipProps) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-pressed={active}
      className={`rounded-full border px-3.5 py-1.5 text-sm font-medium transition-colors ${
        active
          ? 'border-accent-500 bg-accent-500/15 text-accent-300'
          : 'border-line bg-surface-raised text-slate-300 hover:border-accent-500/50 hover:text-slate-100'
      }`}
    >
      {label}
    </button>
  );
}

Content: interface VehicleIllustrationProps {
  category: string;
  /** Make initials shown subtly behind the illustration. */
  initials: string;
}

/**
 * Inline-SVG vehicle illustration chosen by category. A generic car is used
 * for unknown categories, and the make initials are rendered behind the
 * silhouette as a subtle watermark.
 */
export default function VehicleIllustration({ category, initials }: VehicleIllustrationProps) {
  const normalized = category.trim().toLowerCase();
  const Body = pickBody(normalized);

  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 240 120"
      className="h-full w-full"
      role="img"
      aria-label={`${category} illustration`}
    >
      <text
        x="120"
        y="72"
        textAnchor="middle"
        className="fill-white/15 font-display"
        fontSize="44"
        fontWeight="700"
      >
        {initials}
      </text>
      <g transform="translate(20 24)">
        <Body />
      </g>
    </svg>
  );
}

type BodyProps = Record<string, never>;

function pickBody(category: string): (props: BodyProps) => React.ReactElement {
  if (category.includes('suv')) return SuvBody;
  if (category.includes('hatch')) return HatchbackBody;
  if (category.includes('truck')) return TruckBody;
  if (category.includes('coupe')) return CoupeBody;
  if (category.includes('electric') || category.includes('ev')) return ElectricBody;
  if (category.includes('sedan')) return SedanBody;
  return GenericBody;
}

/** Shared gradient for the silhouette fill. */
function Gradient() {
  return (
    <linearGradient id="vehicle-body" x1="0" y1="0" x2="1" y2="0">
      <stop offset="0%" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity="0.95" />
      <stop offset="100%" stopColor="#ffffff" stopOpacity="0.55" />
    </linearGradient>
  );
}

function Wheels() {
  return (
    <g fill="#0B1020" opacity="0.9">
      <circle cx="54" cy="76" r="15" />
      <circle cx="146" cy="76" r="15" />
    </g>
  );
}

function SedanBody() {
  return (
    <g>
      <Gradient />
      <path
        d="M20 78c0-4 2-7 5-9l18-8 16-6 18-3 26 1 20 5 16 8 10 9 4 6a9 9 0 0 1 0 7l-1 3a8 8 0 0 1-8 6H28a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-11z"
        fill="url(#vehicle-body)"
      />
      <Wheels />
    </g>
  );
}

function SuvBody() {
  return (
    <g>
      <Gradient />
      <path
        d="M16 80c0-3 1-6 3-8l14-9 20-7 22-3 20 1 18 5 16 9 10 10 3 6a8 8 0 0 1 0 6l-2 5a8 8 0 0 1-8 6H24a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-13z"
        fill="url(#vehicle-body)"
      />
      <rect x="70" y="26" width="60" height="30" rx="4" fill="#0B1020" opacity="0.45" />
      <Wheels />
    </g>
  );
}

function HatchbackBody() {
  return (
    <g>
      <Gradient />
      <path
        d="M18 80c0-4 1-7 4-9l16-8 20-5 20-1 22 2 18 6 15 9 7 8 1 4a9 9 0 0 1-1 6l-2 4a8 8 0 0 1-8 6H26a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-14z"
        fill="url(#vehicle-body)"
      />
      <path d="M110 62l24 14" stroke="#0B1020" strokeOpacity="0.4" strokeWidth="3" />
      <Wheels />
    </g>
  );
}

function TruckBody() {
  return (
    <g>
      <Gradient />
      <path d="M14 80c0-3 1-6 3-8l14-8 20-6 22-2 20 2 16 6 14 9 6 8v10a8 8 0 0 1-8 8H22a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-11z" fill="url(#vehicle-body)" />
      <rect x="126" y="30" width="52" height="38" rx="3" fill="url(#vehicle-body)" opacity="0.8" />
      <Wheels />
    </g>
  );
}

function CoupeBody() {
  return (
    <g>
      <Gradient />
      <path
        d="M22 80c0-4 1-7 4-9l20-8 22-4 24 1 20 6 16 9 8 9 1 5a8 8 0 0 1-2 6l-3 4a8 8 0 0 1-8 6H30a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-17z"
        fill="url(#vehicle-body)"
      />
      <path d="M96 40c10-8 22-10 34-6" stroke="#0B1020" strokeOpacity="0.4" strokeWidth="3" />
      <Wheels />
    </g>
  );
}

function ElectricBody() {
  return (
    <g>
      <Gradient />
      <path
        d="M20 78c0-4 2-7 5-9l18-8 16-6 18-3 26 1 20 5 16 8 10 9 4 6a9 9 0 0 1 0 7l-1 3a8 8 0 0 1-8 6H28a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-11z"
        fill="url(#vehicle-body)"
      />
      <path d="M120 44l-8 14h10l-8 14" fill="none" stroke="#0B1020" strokeWidth="4" strokeLinecap="round" strokeLinejoin="round" opacity="0.6" />
      <Wheels />
    </g>
  );
}

function GenericBody() {
  return (
    <g>
      <Gradient />
      <path
        d="M20 80c0-4 2-7 5-9l17-8 18-5 20-2 22 2 18 6 15 9 8 9 3 6a9 9 0 0 1 0 7l-2 4a8 8 0 0 1-8 6H28a8 8 0 0 1-8-8v-17z"

      <Wheels />

}

Path: frontend/src/components/VehicleCard.tsx
Content: import { useEffect, useState } from 'react';
import { Pencil, Plus, Trash2 } from 'lucide-react';
import { purchaseVehicle } from '../api/client';
import Spinner from './Spinner';
import VehicleIllustration from './VehicleIllustration';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';

interface VehicleCardProps {
  vehicle: Vehicle;
  onPurchased: (updated: Vehicle) => void;
  onError: () => void;
  onEdit?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onDelete?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onRestock?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
}

const priceFormatter = new Intl.NumberFormat('en-US', {
  style: 'currency',
  currency: 'USD',
});

/** Deterministic, category-tinted gradient for the card header. */
function gradientFor(category: string): string {
  const tints: Record<string, string> = {
    sedan: 'from-sky-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
    suv: 'from-violet-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
    hatchback: 'from-emerald-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
    truck: 'from-amber-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
    coupe: 'from-rose-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
    electric: 'from-cyan-500/30 via-canvas to-canvas',
  };
  return tints[category.trim().toLowerCase()] ?? 'from-accent-500/25 via-canvas to-canvas';
}

/** Upcased initials of the make (first letters of each word). */
function initialsOf(make: string): string {
  return make
    .split(/\s+/)
    .map((word) => word.charAt(0))
    .join('')
    .toUpperCase();
}

/** Stock metadata: text label, tone and a progress ratio out of 10. */
function stockInfo(quantity: number): { label: string; tone: 'ok' | 'warn' | 'danger' } {
  if (quantity === 0) return { label: 'Out of stock', tone: 'danger' };
  if (quantity <= 3) return { label: `Only ${quantity} left`, tone: 'warn' };
  return { label: `${quantity} in stock`, tone: 'ok' };
}

const TONE_TEXT: Record<string, string> = {
  ok: 'text-ok',
  warn: 'text-warn',
  danger: 'text-danger',
};

const TONE_BAR: Record<string, string> = {
  ok: 'bg-ok',
  warn: 'bg-warn',
  danger: 'bg-danger',
};

/**
 * Presents a single vehicle with a category illustration header, big price,
 * stock indicator with progress bar, purchase action and inline errors. Admins
 * additionally get a compact icon row for Edit, Restock and Delete.
 */
export default function VehicleCard({
  vehicle,
  onPurchased,
  onError,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onRestock,
}: VehicleCardProps) {
  const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
  const [current, setCurrent] = useState(vehicle);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  // Reflect parent-side updates (e.g. restock/edit replacing the vehicle).
  useEffect(() => {
    setCurrent(vehicle);
  }, [vehicle]);

  async function handlePurchase() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      const updated = await purchaseVehicle(current.id);
      setCurrent(updated);
      onPurchased(updated);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
      onError();
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  const outOfStock = current.quantity === 0;
  const stock = stockInfo(current.quantity);
  const stockRatio = Math.min(current.quantity / 10, 1);

  return (
    <article className="group flex flex-col overflow-hidden rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface shadow-card transition-all duration-200 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:border-accent-500/40 hover:shadow-card-hover">
      <div
        className={`relative flex h-36 items-center justify-center bg-gradient-to-br ${gradientFor(current.category)}`}
        aria-hidden="true"
      >
        <div className="absolute inset-x-0 top-0 flex items-center justify-between px-4 pt-3">
          <span className="rounded-full border border-white/20 bg-white/10 px-2.5 py-0.5 text-xs font-medium text-white backdrop-blur-sm">
            {current.category}
          </span>
        </div>
        <div className="h-full w-4/5">
          <VehicleIllustration category={current.category} initials={initialsOf(current.make)} />
        </div>
      </div>

      <div className="flex flex-1 flex-col p-5">
        <p className="text-xs font-semibold uppercase tracking-wider text-accent-400">
          {current.make}
        </p>
        <h3 className="mt-1 font-display text-lg font-semibold text-white">{current.model}</h3>

        <p className="tabular-nums mt-2 font-display text-2xl font-bold text-white">
          {priceFormatter.format(current.price)}
        </p>

        {/* Stock indicator: text plus progress bar so colour is not the only cue. */}
        <div className="mt-4">
          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-2">
            <span className={`text-xs font-semibold ${TONE_TEXT[stock.tone]}`}>{stock.label}</span>
            <span className="text-xs text-slate-500">
              {stockRatio >= 1 ? 'Full' : `${Math.round(stockRatio * 100)}%`}
            </span>
          </div>
          <div className="mt-1.5 h-1.5 overflow-hidden rounded-full bg-line">
            <div
              className={`h-full rounded-full ${TONE_BAR[stock.tone]} transition-all duration-300`}
              style={{ width: `${Math.max(stockRatio * 100, 4)}%` }}
            />
          </div>
        </div>

        {isAdmin && (
          <div className="mt-4 flex items-center gap-2">
            <AdminIconButton
              label={`Edit ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
              onClick={() => onEdit?.(current)}
              tone="default"
            >
              <Pencil className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </AdminIconButton>
            <AdminIconButton
              label={`Restock ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
              onClick={() => onRestock?.(current)}
              tone="default"
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </AdminIconButton>
            <AdminIconButton
              label={`Delete ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
              onClick={() => onDelete?.(current)}
              tone="danger"
            >
              <Trash2 className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
            </AdminIconButton>
          </div>
        )}

        <div className="mt-4 flex-1" />

        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handlePurchase}
          disabled={outOfStock || loading}
          aria-label={`Purchase ${current.make} ${current.model}`}
          className="inline-flex w-full items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:bg-none disabled:bg-surface-200 disabled:text-slate-500 disabled:shadow-none"
        >
          {loading && <Spinner />}
          {loading ? 'Purchasing…' : outOfStock ? 'Sold out' : 'Purchase'}
        </button>

        <div aria-live="polite" className="mt-3 min-h-[1.25rem]">
          {error && <p className="text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>}
        </div>
      </div>
    </article>
  );
}

interface AdminIconButtonProps {
  label: string;
  onClick: () => void;
  tone: 'default' | 'danger';
  children: React.ReactNode;
}

function AdminIconButton({ label, onClick, tone, children }: AdminIconButtonProps) {
  return (
    <button
      type="button"
      onClick={onClick}
      aria-label={label}
      title={label}
      className={`rounded-lg border p-2 transition-colors ${
        tone === 'danger'
          ? 'border-line text-slate-400 hover:border-danger/50 hover:text-danger'
          : 'border-line text-slate-400 hover:border-accent-500/50 hover:text-accent-400'
      }`}
    >
      {children}
    </button>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/components/VehicleGrid.tsx
Content: import { AlertTriangle, Car, SearchX } from 'lucide-react';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';
import VehicleCard from './VehicleCard';

interface VehicleGridProps {
  vehicles: Vehicle[];
  loading: boolean;
  error: string | null;
  onClearFilters: () => void;
  onRetry: () => void;
  onPurchased: (updated: Vehicle) => void;
  onError: () => void;
  onEdit?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onDelete?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
  onRestock?: (vehicle: Vehicle) => void;
}

/**
 * Responsive grid of vehicle cards with shimmer skeleton loading, an
 * illustrated empty state and an error state with retry.
 */
export default function VehicleGrid({
  vehicles,
  loading,
  error,
  onClearFilters,
  onRetry,
  onPurchased,
  onError,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
  onRestock,
}: VehicleGridProps) {
  if (loading) {
    return (
      <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
        {Array.from({ length: 8 }).map((_, index) => (
          <SkeletonCard key={index} />
        ))}
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (error) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface p-10 text-center shadow-card">
        <span className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-danger-muted">
          <AlertTriangle className="h-6 w-6 text-danger" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
        <h3 className="mt-4 font-display text-lg font-semibold text-white">
          We couldn't load the showroom
        </h3>
        <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm text-slate-400">{error}</p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onRetry}
          className="mt-5 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110"
        >
          Retry
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  if (vehicles.length === 0) {
    return (
      <div className="rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface p-10 text-center shadow-card">
        <span className="mx-auto flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-surface-200">
          <SearchX className="h-6 w-6 text-slate-400" aria-hidden="true" />
        </span>
        <h3 className="mt-4 font-display text-lg font-semibold text-white">
          No vehicles match your filters
        </h3>
        <p className="mx-auto mt-2 max-w-sm text-sm text-slate-400">
          Try adjusting the filters to see more of the inventory.
        </p>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onClearFilters}
          className="mt-5 rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface-raised px-5 py-2.5 text-sm font-medium text-slate-200 transition-colors hover:border-accent-500/50 hover:text-white"
        >
          Clear filters
        </button>
      </div>
    );
  }

  return (
    <div className="grid grid-cols-1 gap-6 sm:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 xl:grid-cols-4">
      {vehicles.map((vehicle, index) => (
        <div
          key={vehicle.id}
          className="animate-card"
          style={{ animationDelay: `${Math.min(index * 40, 400)}ms` }}
        >
          <VehicleCard
            vehicle={vehicle}
            onPurchased={onPurchased}
            onError={onError}
            onEdit={onEdit}
            onDelete={onDelete}
            onRestock={onRestock}
          />
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

/** Shimmer placeholder matching the vehicle card layout. */
function SkeletonCard() {
  return (
    <div
      className="overflow-hidden rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface shadow-card"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      <div className="h-36 animate-pulse bg-surface-200" />
      <div className="space-y-3 p-5">
        <div className="h-3 w-1/3 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-200" />
        <div className="h-5 w-2/3 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-200" />
        <div className="h-7 w-1/2 animate-pulse rounded bg-surface-200" />
        <div className="h-1.5 w-full animate-pulse rounded-full bg-surface-200" />
        <div className="h-10 w-full animate-pulse rounded-lg bg-surface-200" />
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Content: import { useMemo, useState } from 'react';
import { Car, Layers, Plus, PackageCheck } from 'lucide-react';
import {
  createVehicle,
  deleteVehicle,
  restockVehicle,
  updateVehicle,
  type CreateVehicleInput,
  type UpdateVehicleInput,
} from '../api/client';
import ConfirmDeleteModal from '../components/ConfirmDeleteModal';
import RestockModal from '../components/RestockModal';
import VehicleFilters from '../components/VehicleFilters';
import VehicleFormModal from '../components/VehicleFormModal';
import VehicleGrid from '../components/VehicleGrid';
import { useAuth } from '../context/AuthContext';
import { useToast } from '../context/ToastContext';
import { useVehicles } from '../hooks/useVehicles';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';

type ModalState =
  | { type: 'add' }
  | { type: 'edit'; vehicle: Vehicle }
  | { type: 'delete'; vehicle: Vehicle }
  | { type: 'restock'; vehicle: Vehicle }
  | null;

/**
 * Inventory dashboard: hero banner with stats strip, sticky filters and the
 * vehicle grid. Admins can add, edit, restock and delete through modals.
 * Success feedback is delivered through toasts.
 */
export default function DashboardPage() {
  const { vehicles, loading, error, applyFilters, refresh, replaceVehicle } = useVehicles();
  const { isAdmin } = useAuth();
  const { toast } = useToast();
  const [modal, setModal] = useState<ModalState>(null);

  const categories = useMemo(
    () => Array.from(new Set(vehicles.map((vehicle) => vehicle.category))).sort(),
    [vehicles],
  );

  const inStock = useMemo(
    () => vehicles.filter((vehicle) => vehicle.quantity > 0).length,
    [vehicles],
  );

  function clearFilters() {
    void applyFilters({});
  }

  async function handleAdd(data: CreateVehicleInput | UpdateVehicleInput) {
    await createVehicle(data as CreateVehicleInput);
    setModal(null);
    toast(`${data.make} ${data.model} added`);
    await refresh();
  }

  async function handleEdit(vehicle: Vehicle, data: CreateVehicleInput | UpdateVehicleInput) {
    const updated = await updateVehicle(vehicle.id, data as UpdateVehicleInput);
    replaceVehicle(updated);
    setModal(null);
    toast(`${updated.make} ${updated.model} updated`);
  }

  async function handleDelete(vehicle: Vehicle) {
    await deleteVehicle(vehicle.id);
    setModal(null);
    toast(`${vehicle.make} ${vehicle.model} deleted`);
    await refresh();
  }

  async function handleRestock(vehicle: Vehicle, quantity: number) {
    const updated = await restockVehicle(vehicle.id, quantity);
    replaceVehicle(updated);
    setModal(null);
    toast(`${updated.make} ${updated.model} restocked`);
  }

  return (
    <div className="mx-auto max-w-6xl px-4 py-8 sm:px-6">
      {/* Hero banner */}
      <section className="relative overflow-hidden rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-gradient-to-br from-surface-raised via-surface to-canvas p-6 shadow-card sm:p-8">
        <div className="pointer-events-none absolute -right-10 -top-10 h-48 w-48 rounded-full bg-accent-500/20 blur-3xl" />
        <div className="relative flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <div>
            <h1 className="font-display text-2xl font-semibold text-white sm:text-3xl">
              The showroom floor
            </h1>
            <p className="mt-2 max-w-lg text-sm text-slate-400">
              Every vehicle in inventory, ready to browse, filter and manage.
            </p>
          </div>
          {isAdmin && (
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setModal({ type: 'add' })}
              className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2.5 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110"
            >
              <Plus className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
              Add vehicle
            </button>
          )}
        </div>

        {/* Stats strip */}
        <dl className="relative mt-6 grid grid-cols-1 gap-3 sm:grid-cols-3">
          <Stat icon={<Car className="h-5 w-5 text-accent-400" aria-hidden="true" />} label="Total vehicles" value={String(vehicles.length)} />
          <Stat icon={<PackageCheck className="h-5 w-5 text-ok" aria-hidden="true" />} label="In stock" value={String(inStock)} />
          <Stat icon={<Layers className="h-5 w-5 text-warn" aria-hidden="true" />} label="Categories" value={String(categories.length)} />
        </dl>
      </section>

      <div className="mt-6">
        <VehicleFilters categories={categories} onApply={(filters) => void applyFilters(filters)} />
      </div>

      <div className="mt-8">
        <VehicleGrid
          vehicles={vehicles}
          loading={loading}
          error={error}
          onClearFilters={clearFilters}
          onRetry={() => void refresh()}
          onPurchased={replaceVehicle}
          onError={() => void refresh()}
          onEdit={isAdmin ? (vehicle) => setModal({ type: 'edit', vehicle }) : undefined}
          onDelete={isAdmin ? (vehicle) => setModal({ type: 'delete', vehicle }) : undefined}
          onRestock={isAdmin ? (vehicle) => setModal({ type: 'restock', vehicle }) : undefined}
        />
      </div>

      {modal?.type === 'add' && (
        <VehicleFormModal
          mode="add"
          initialVehicle={null}
          categories={categories}
          onSubmit={handleAdd}
          onClose={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}

      {modal?.type === 'edit' && (
        <VehicleFormModal
          mode="edit"
          initialVehicle={modal.vehicle}
          categories={categories}
          onSubmit={(data) => handleEdit(modal.vehicle, data)}
          onClose={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}

      {modal?.type === 'delete' && (
        <ConfirmDeleteModal
          vehicleName={`${modal.vehicle.make} ${modal.vehicle.model}`}
          onConfirm={() => handleDelete(modal.vehicle)}
          onCancel={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}

      {modal?.type === 'restock' && (
        <RestockModal
          vehicleName={`${modal.vehicle.make} ${modal.vehicle.model}`}
          currentStock={modal.vehicle.quantity}
          onSubmit={(quantity) => handleRestock(modal.vehicle, quantity)}
          onClose={() => setModal(null)}
        />
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

interface StatProps {
  icon: React.ReactNode;
  label: string;
  value: string;
}

function Stat({ icon, label, value }: StatProps) {
  return (
    <div className="flex items-center gap-3 rounded-xl border border-line bg-surface/70 px-4 py-3">
      <span className="flex h-10 w-10 items-center justify-center rounded-lg bg-surface-200">
        {icon}
      </span>
      <div>
        <dd className="tabular-nums font-display text-xl font-bold text-white">{value}</dd>
        <dt className="text-xs text-slate-400">{label}</dt>
      </div>
    </div>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/components/Modal.tsx
Content: import { useEffect, useRef, type ReactNode } from 'react';
import { createPortal } from 'react-dom';
import { X } from 'lucide-react';

interface ModalProps {
  title: string;
  onClose: () => void;
  children: ReactNode;
}

/** Selectors for elements that can receive keyboard focus. */
const FOCUSABLE =
  'a[href], button:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';

/**
 * Accessible modal shell rendered in a portal.
 * Sets aria-modal, closes on Escape and backdrop click, traps focus while
 * open and restores focus to the previously focused element on close.
 */
export default function Modal({ title, onClose, children }: ModalProps) {
  const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const previouslyFocusedRef = useRef<Element | null>(null);

  useEffect(() => {
    previouslyFocusedRef.current = document.activeElement;

    // Move focus into the dialog on open.
    const dialog = dialogRef.current;
    dialog?.focus();

    return () => {
      // Restore focus to the trigger on close.
      if (previouslyFocusedRef.current instanceof HTMLElement) {
        previouslyFocusedRef.current.focus();
      }
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
      if (event.key === 'Escape') {
        event.preventDefault();
        onClose();
        return;
      }

      if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;

      const dialog = dialogRef.current;
      if (!dialog) return;

      const focusable = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE));

      if (focusable.length === 0) {
        event.preventDefault();
        dialog.focus();
        return;
      }

      const first = focusable[0];
      const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];

      if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
        event.preventDefault();
        last.focus();
      } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
        event.preventDefault();
        first.focus();
      }
    }

    document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
    return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
  }, [onClose]);

  return createPortal(
    <div
      className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
      data-testid="modal-backdrop"
      onClick={onClose}
    >
      <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-canvas/80 backdrop-blur-sm" aria-hidden="true" />
      <div
        ref={dialogRef}
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="modal-title"
        tabIndex={-1}
        onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
        className="relative w-full max-w-md rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface-raised p-6 shadow-modal animate-modal-in focus:outline-none"
      >
        <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
          <h2 id="modal-title" className="font-display text-lg font-semibold text-white">
            {title}
          </h2>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            aria-label="Close dialog"
            className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-200 hover:text-white"
          >
            <X className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" />
          </button>
        </div>
        {children}
      </div>
    </div>,
    document.body,
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/components/ConfirmDeleteModal.tsx
Content: import { useState } from 'react';
import { AlertTriangle } from 'lucide-react';
import Modal from './Modal';
import Spinner from './Spinner';

interface ConfirmDeleteModalProps {
  vehicleName: string;
  onConfirm: () => Promise<void>;
  onCancel: () => void;
}

/**
 * Delete confirmation dialog. Names the vehicle, shows a destructive Delete
 * action with a loading state, and renders any server error inline.
 */
export default function ConfirmDeleteModal({
  vehicleName,
  onConfirm,
  onCancel,
}: ConfirmDeleteModalProps) {
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);

  async function handleConfirm() {
    setLoading(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await onConfirm();
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal title="Delete vehicle" onClose={onCancel}>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-start gap-3 rounded-xl border border-danger/30 bg-danger-muted p-3">
        <AlertTriangle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-danger" aria-hidden="true" />
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-200">
          Are you sure you want to delete <span className="font-medium text-white">{vehicleName}</span>?
          This action cannot be undone.
        </p>
      </div>

      {error && <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>}

      <div className="mt-6 flex justify-end gap-3">
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={onCancel}
          disabled={loading}
          className="rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-200 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-200 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          Cancel
        </button>
        <button
          type="button"
          onClick={handleConfirm}
          disabled={loading}
          className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-danger px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white transition-colors hover:brightness-110 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
        >
          {loading && <Spinner />}
          {loading ? 'Deleting…' : 'Delete'}
        </button>
      </div>
    </Modal>
  );
}

Path: frontend/src/components/RestockModal.tsx
Content: import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import { PackagePlus } from 'lucide-react';
import Modal from './Modal';
import Spinner from './Spinner';

interface RestockModalProps {
  vehicleName: string;
  currentStock: number;
  onSubmit: (quantity: number) => Promise<void>;
  onClose: () => void;
}

/**
 * Restock dialog. Accepts a positive integer quantity, shows the current
 * stock, validates client-side and renders any server error inline.
 */
export default function RestockModal({
  vehicleName,
  currentStock,
  onSubmit,
  onClose,
}: RestockModalProps) {
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState('');
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setError(null);

    const parsed = Number(quantity);
    if (quantity.trim() === '' || Number.isNaN(parsed) || parsed <= 0) {
      setError('Quantity must be greater than 0');
      return;
    }
    if (!Number.isInteger(parsed)) {
      setError('Quantity must be an integer');
      return;
    }

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await onSubmit(parsed);
    } catch (err) {
      setError(err instanceof Error ? err.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal title="Restock vehicle" onClose={onClose}>
      <div className="mt-3 flex items-center gap-2 rounded-xl border border-line bg-surface p-3">
        <PackagePlus className="h-5 w-5 text-accent-400" aria-hidden="true" />
        <p className="text-sm text-slate-300">
          {vehicleName} — current stock: <span className="font-semibold text-white">{currentStock}</span>
        </p>
      </div>

      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate className="mt-4 space-y-4">
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="restock-quantity" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
            Quantity to add
          </label>
          <input
            id="restock-quantity"
            type="number"
            min="1"
            value={quantity}
            onChange={(event) => setQuantity(event.target.value)}
            className="mt-1.5 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-100 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500"
          />
          {error && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{error}</p>}
        </div>

        <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={loading}
            className="rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-200 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-200 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {loading && <Spinner />}
            {loading ? 'Restocking…' : 'Restock'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

Content: import { useState, type FormEvent } from 'react';
import type { CreateVehicleInput, UpdateVehicleInput } from '../api/client';
import type { Vehicle } from '../types';
import Modal from './Modal';
import Spinner from './Spinner';

interface VehicleFormModalProps {
  mode: 'add' | 'edit';
  initialVehicle: Vehicle | null;
  categories: string[];
  onSubmit: (data: CreateVehicleInput | UpdateVehicleInput) => Promise<void>;
  onClose: () => void;
}

interface FieldErrors {
  make?: string;
  model?: string;
  category?: string;
  price?: string;
  quantity?: string;
}

const EMPTY_FIELDS: FieldErrors = {};

/** Parses an integer quantity input, treating an empty string as 0. */
function parseQuantity(value: string): number {
  if (value.trim() === '') return 0;
  return Number(value);
}

/** Validates the form values against the backend contract. */
function validate(values: {
  make: string;
  model: string;
  category: string;
  price: string;
  quantity: string;
}): FieldErrors {
  const errors: FieldErrors = {};

  if (values.make.trim() === '') errors.make = 'Make is required';
  if (values.model.trim() === '') errors.model = 'Model is required';
  if (values.category.trim() === '') errors.category = 'Category is required';

  const price = Number(values.price);
  if (values.price.trim() === '' || Number.isNaN(price) || price <= 0) {
    errors.price = 'Price must be greater than 0';
  }

  const quantity = parseQuantity(values.quantity);
  if (values.quantity.trim() !== '') {
    if (!Number.isInteger(quantity)) {
      errors.quantity = 'Quantity must be an integer';
    } else if (quantity < 0) {
      errors.quantity = 'Quantity cannot be negative';
    }
  }

  return errors;
}

const inputClass =
  'mt-1.5 w-full rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface px-3 py-2 text-sm text-slate-100 placeholder:text-slate-500 transition-colors focus:border-accent-500 focus:ring-1 focus:ring-accent-500';

/**
 * Add/edit form for a vehicle, rendered inside an accessible modal.
 * Validates client-side, shows inline errors and the server error, and in
 * edit mode submits only the fields that changed from the initial vehicle.
 */
export default function VehicleFormModal({
  mode,
  initialVehicle,
  categories,
  onSubmit,
  onClose,
}: VehicleFormModalProps) {
  const [make, setMake] = useState(initialVehicle?.make ?? '');
  const [model, setModel] = useState(initialVehicle?.model ?? '');
  const [category, setCategory] = useState(initialVehicle?.category ?? '');
  const [price, setPrice] = useState(initialVehicle ? String(initialVehicle.price) : '');
  const [quantity, setQuantity] = useState(
    initialVehicle ? String(initialVehicle.quantity) : '',
  );
  const [fieldErrors, setFieldErrors] = useState<FieldErrors>(EMPTY_FIELDS);
  const [serverError, setServerError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false);

  const isEdit = mode === 'edit';

  async function handleSubmit(event: FormEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    setServerError(null);

    const values = { make, model, category, price, quantity };
    const errors = validate(values);
    setFieldErrors(errors);
    if (Object.keys(errors).length > 0) return;

    const payload: CreateVehicleInput | UpdateVehicleInput = isEdit
      ? buildChanges(values, initialVehicle!)
      : {
          make: make.trim(),
          model: model.trim(),
          category: category.trim(),
          price: Number(price),
          quantity: parseQuantity(quantity),
        };

    setLoading(true);
    try {
      await onSubmit(payload);
    } catch (error) {
      setServerError(error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Something went wrong');
    } finally {
      setLoading(false);
    }
  }

  return (
    <Modal title={isEdit ? 'Edit vehicle' : 'Add vehicle'} onClose={onClose}>
      <form onSubmit={handleSubmit} noValidate className="mt-4 space-y-4">
        <div>
          <label htmlFor="vehicle-make" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
            Make
          </label>
          <input
            id="vehicle-make"
            type="text"
            value={make}
            onChange={(event) => setMake(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
          />
          {fieldErrors.make && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.make}</p>}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="vehicle-model" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
            Model
          </label>
          <input
            id="vehicle-model"
            type="text"
            value={model}
            onChange={(event) => setModel(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
          />
          {fieldErrors.model && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.model}</p>}
        </div>

        <div>
          <label htmlFor="vehicle-category" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
            Category
          </label>
          <input
            id="vehicle-category"
            type="text"
            list="vehicle-categories"
            value={category}
            onChange={(event) => setCategory(event.target.value)}
            className={inputClass}
          />
          <datalist id="vehicle-categories">
            {categories.map((option) => (
              <option key={option} value={option} />
            ))}
          </datalist>
          {fieldErrors.category && (
            <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.category}</p>
          )}
        </div>

        <div className="grid grid-cols-2 gap-4">
          <div>
            <label htmlFor="vehicle-price" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
              Price
            </label>
            <input
              id="vehicle-price"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              value={price}
              onChange={(event) => setPrice(event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            />
            {fieldErrors.price && <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.price}</p>}
          </div>

          <div>
            <label htmlFor="vehicle-quantity" className="block text-sm font-medium text-slate-300">
              Quantity
            </label>
            <input
              id="vehicle-quantity"
              type="number"
              min="0"
              value={quantity}
              onChange={(event) => setQuantity(event.target.value)}
              className={inputClass}
            />
            {fieldErrors.quantity && (
              <p className="mt-1.5 text-sm text-danger">{fieldErrors.quantity}</p>
            )}
          </div>
        </div>

        {serverError && <p className="text-sm text-danger">{serverError}</p>}

        <div className="flex justify-end gap-3 pt-2">
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={loading}
            className="rounded-lg border border-line bg-surface px-4 py-2 text-sm font-medium text-slate-200 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-200 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            Cancel
          </button>
          <button
            type="submit"
            disabled={loading}
            className="inline-flex items-center gap-2 rounded-lg bg-gradient-accent px-4 py-2 text-sm font-semibold text-white shadow-glow transition-all hover:brightness-110 disabled:cursor-not-allowed disabled:opacity-60"
          >
            {loading && <Spinner />}
            {loading ? 'Saving…' : isEdit ? 'Save changes' : 'Add vehicle'}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </Modal>
  );
}

/** Computes the subset of fields that differ from the initial vehicle. */
function buildChanges(
  values: { make: string; model: string; category: string; price: string; quantity: string },
  initial: Vehicle,
): UpdateVehicleInput {
  const changes: UpdateVehicleInput = {};

  const make = values.make.trim();
  const model = values.model.trim();
  const category = values.category.trim();
  const price = Number(values.price);
  const quantity = parseQuantity(values.quantity);

  if (make !== initial.make) changes.make = make;
  if (model !== initial.model) changes.model = model;
  if (category !== initial.category) changes.category = category;
  if (price !== initial.price) changes.price = price;
  if (quantity !== initial.quantity) changes.quantity = quantity;

  return changes;
}

14 | 
15 | interface Toast {
16 |   id: number;
17 |   message: string;

19 | }
20 | 
21 | interface ToastContextValue {
22 |   toast: (message: string, tone?: ToastTone) => void;
23 | }
24 | 
25 | const ToastContext = createContext<ToastContextValue | undefined>(undefined);
26 | 
27 | const AUTO_DISMISS_MS = 4000;
28 | 
29 | /**
30 |  * Provides a lightweight toast system. Toasts stack in the bottom-right on
31 |  * desktop and across the top on mobile, auto-dismiss and can be dismissed.
32 |  */
33 | export function ToastProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
34 |   const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);
35 |   const idRef = useRef(0);
36 | 
37 |   const dismiss = useCallback((id: number) => {
38 |     setToasts((current) => current.filter((toast) => toast.id !== id));
39 |   }, []);
40 | 
41 |   const toast = useCallback(
42 |     (message: string, tone: ToastTone = 'success') => {
43 |       const id = ++idRef.current;
44 |       setToasts((current) => [...current, { id, message, tone }]);
45 |       window.setTimeout(() => dismiss(id), AUTO_DISMISS_MS);
46 |     },
47 |     [dismiss],
48 |   );
49 | 
50 |   const value = useMemo<ToastContextValue>(() => ({ toast }), [toast]);
51 | 
52 |   return (
53 |     <ToastContext.Provider value={value}>
54 |       {children}
55 |       {createPortal(
56 |         <div
57 |           aria-live="polite"
58 |           aria-label="Notifications"
59 |           className="pointer-events-none fixed inset-x-0 top-0 z-[60] flex flex-col items-center gap-2 px-4 pt-4 sm:inset-x-auto sm:bottom-4 sm:right-4 sm:top-auto sm:items-end sm:px-0 sm:pt-0"
60 |         >
61 |           {toasts.map((item) => (
62 |             <div
63 |               key={item.id}
64 |               role="status"
65 |               className="pointer-events-auto flex w-full max-w-sm items-start gap-3 rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface-raised px-4 py-3 shadow-modal animate-toast-in"
66 |             >
67 |               {item.tone === 'success' ? (
68 |                 <CheckCircle2 className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-ok" aria-hidden="true" />
69 |               ) : (
70 |                 <XCircle className="mt-0.5 h-5 w-5 shrink-0 text-danger" aria-hidden="true" />
71 |               )}
72 |               <p className="flex-1 text-sm text-slate-100">{item.message}</p>
73 |               <button
74 |                 type="button"
75 |                 onClick={() => dismiss(item.id)}
76 |                 aria-label="Dismiss notification"
77 |                 className="rounded-md p-1 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-200 hover:text-slate-100"
78 |               >
79 |                 <X className="h-4 w-4" aria-hidden="true" />
80 |               </button>
81 |             </div>
82 |           ))}
83 |         </div>,
84 |         document.body,
85 |       )}
86 |     </ToastContext.Provider>

  5 | interface ModalProps {
  6 |   title: string;
  7 |   onClose: () => void;
  8 |   children: ReactNode;
  9 | }
 10 | 
 11 | /** Selectors for elements that can receive keyboard focus. */
 12 | const FOCUSABLE =
 13 |   'a[href], button:not([disabled]), textarea:not([disabled]), input:not([disabled]), select:not([disabled]), [tabindex]:not([tabindex="-1"])';
 14 | 
 15 | /**
 16 |  * Accessible modal shell rendered in a portal.
 17 |  * Sets aria-modal, closes on Escape and backdrop click, traps focus while
 18 |  * open and restores focus to the previously focused element on close.
 19 |  */
 20 | export default function Modal({ title, onClose, children }: ModalProps) {
 21 |   const dialogRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
 22 |   const previouslyFocusedRef = useRef<Element | null>(null);
 23 | 
 24 |   useEffect(() => {
 25 |     previouslyFocusedRef.current = document.activeElement;
 26 | 
 27 |     // Move focus into the dialog on open.
 28 |     const dialog = dialogRef.current;
 29 |     dialog?.focus();
 30 | 
 31 |     return () => {
 32 |       // Restore focus to the trigger on close.
 33 |       if (previouslyFocusedRef.current instanceof HTMLElement) {
 34 |         previouslyFocusedRef.current.focus();
 35 |       }
 36 |     };
 37 |   }, []);
 38 | 
 39 |   useEffect(() => {
 40 |     function handleKeyDown(event: KeyboardEvent) {
 41 |       if (event.key === 'Escape') {
 42 |         event.preventDefault();
 43 |         onClose();
 44 |         return;
 45 |       }
 46 | 
 47 |       if (event.key !== 'Tab') return;
 48 | 
 49 |       const dialog = dialogRef.current;
 50 |       if (!dialog) return;
 51 | 
 52 |       const focusable = Array.from(dialog.querySelectorAll<HTMLElement>(FOCUSABLE));
 53 | 
 54 |       if (focusable.length === 0) {
 55 |         event.preventDefault();
 56 |         dialog.focus();
 57 |         return;
 58 |       }
 59 | 
 60 |       const first = focusable[0];
 61 |       const last = focusable[focusable.length - 1];
 62 | 
 63 |       if (event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === first) {
 64 |         event.preventDefault();
 65 |         last.focus();
 66 |       } else if (!event.shiftKey && document.activeElement === last) {
 67 |         event.preventDefault();
 68 |         first.focus();
 69 |       }
 70 |     }
 71 | 
 72 |     document.addEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
 73 |     return () => document.removeEventListener('keydown', handleKeyDown);
 74 |   }, [onClose]);
 75 | 
 76 |   return createPortal(
 77 |     <div
 78 |       className="fixed inset-0 z-50 flex items-center justify-center p-4"
 79 |       data-testid="modal-backdrop"
 80 |       onClick={onClose}
 81 |     >
 82 |       <div className="absolute inset-0 bg-canvas/80 backdrop-blur-sm" aria-hidden="true" />
 83 |       <div
 84 |         ref={dialogRef}
 85 |         role="dialog"
 86 |         aria-modal="true"
 87 |         aria-labelledby="modal-title"
 88 |         tabIndex={-1}
 89 |         onClick={(event) => event.stopPropagation()}
 90 |         className="relative w-full max-w-md rounded-xl2 border border-line bg-surface-raised p-6 shadow-modal animate-modal-in focus:outline-none"
 91 |       >
 92 |         <div className="flex items-start justify-between gap-4">
 93 |           <h2 id="modal-title" className="font-display text-lg font-semibold text-white">
 94 |             {title}
 95 |           </h2>
 96 |           <button
 97 |             type="button"
 98 |             onClick={onClose}
 99 |             aria-label="Close dialog"
100 |             className="rounded-lg p-1.5 text-slate-400 transition-colors hover:bg-surface-200 hover:text-white"
101 |           >
102 |             <X className="h-5 w-5" aria-hidden="true" />
103 |           </button>
104 |         </div>
105 |         {children}
106 |       </div>
107 |     </div>,
108 |     document.body,
109 |   );
110 | }

```tsx
import { act, render, screen, waitFor } from '@testing-library/react';
import userEvent from '@testing-library/user-event';
import { MemoryRouter, Route, Routes } from 'react-router-dom';
import { beforeEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest';
import LoginPage from './LoginPage';

const { login, useAuth } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
  login: vi.fn(),
  useAuth: vi.fn(),
}));

vi.mock('../context/AuthContext', () => ({
  useAuth: () => useAuth(),
}));

describe('LoginPage', () => {
  beforeEach(() => {
    login.mockReset();
    login.mockResolvedValue(undefined);
    useAuth.mockReset();
    useAuth.mockReturnValue({ login, token: null });
  });

  function renderPage() {
    return render(
      <MemoryRouter>
        <LoginPage />
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );
  }

  function renderPageWithRoutes() {
    return render(
      <MemoryRouter initialEntries={['/login']}>
        <Routes>
          <Route path="/login" element={<LoginPage />} />
          <Route path="/" element={<div>Dashboard</div>} />
        </Routes>
      </MemoryRouter>,
    );
  }

  it('shows validation errors for an invalid email and a short password', async () => {
    renderPage();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i), 'not-an-email');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^password/i), 'short');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText(/valid email/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.getByText(/at least 8 characters/i)).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(login).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
  });

  it('calls the API on valid submit', async () => {
    renderPage();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i), 'a@example.com');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^password/i), 'password123');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(login).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a@example.com', 'password123'));
  });

  it('shows a server error when the API rejects', async () => {
    login.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Invalid credentials'));
    renderPage();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i), 'a@example.com');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^password/i), 'password123');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('Invalid credentials')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('disables the submit button while loading', async () => {
    let resolveLogin!: () => void;
    login.mockReturnValue(new Promise<void>((resolve) => (resolveLogin = resolve)));
    renderPage();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i), 'a@example.com');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^password/i), 'password123');

    const button = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i });
    await userEvent.click(button);

    await waitFor(() => expect(button).toBeDisabled());
    await act(async () => {
      resolveLogin();
    });
  });

  it('navigates to / after a successful login', async () => {
    renderPageWithRoutes();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i), 'a@example.com');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^password/i), 'password123');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('Dashboard')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('redirects to / instead of the form when a token is already present', async () => {
    useAuth.mockReturnValue({ login, token: 'jwt-token' });
    renderPageWithRoutes();

    expect(await screen.findByText('Dashboard')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /log in/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});
```

    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i), 'a@example.com');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^password/i), 'password123');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i }));

    await waitFor(() => expect(login).toHaveBeenCalledWith('a@example.com', 'password123'));
  });

  it('shows a server error when the API rejects', async () => {
    login.mockRejectedValue(new Error('Invalid credentials'));
    renderPage();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i), 'a@example.com');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^password/i), 'password123');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('Invalid credentials')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('disables the submit button while loading', async () => {
    let resolveLogin!: () => void;
    login.mockReturnValue(new Promise<void>((resolve) => (resolveLogin = resolve)));
    renderPage();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i), 'a@example.com');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^password/i), 'password123');

    const button = screen.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i });
    await userEvent.click(button);

    await waitFor(() => expect(button).toBeDisabled());
    await act(async () => {
      resolveLogin();
    });
  });

  it('navigates to / after a successful login', async () => {
    renderPageWithRoutes();
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/email/i), 'a@example.com');
    await userEvent.type(screen.getByLabelText(/^password/i), 'password123');
    await userEvent.click(screen.getByRole('button', { name: /log in/i }));

    expect(await screen.findByText('Dashboard')).toBeInTheDocument();
  });

  it('redirects to / instead of the form when a token is already present', async () => {
    useAuth.mockReturnValue({ login, token: 'jwt-token' });
    renderPageWithRoutes();

    expect(await screen.findByText('Dashboard')).toBeInTheDocument();
    expect(screen.queryByRole('button', { name: /log in/i })).not.toBeInTheDocument();
  });
});

- **Redesigned**: Navbar, Login/Register pages, Dashboard (hero + stats strip + sticky filters), VehicleCard (SVG illustration, gradient price, stock progress bar, admin icon row), VehicleGrid (skeleton/empty/error states), and all modals.
- **index.html**: page title "Showroom — Car Dealership Inventory", inline SVG favicon, meta description.

## Test assertion changes (updated only where the redesign legitimately changed markup; no test was deleted or weakened)
1. [`Navbar.test.tsx`](frontend/src/components/Navbar.test.tsx:43) — "Car Dealership" → "Showroom"; User badge `bg-slate-100`/`text-slate-700` → `bg-surface-200`/`text-slate-300`; Admin badge `bg-accent-100`/`text-accent-700` → `bg-accent-500/15`/`text-accent-300`.
2. [`LoginPage.test.tsx`](frontend/src/pages/LoginPage.test.tsx:46) — `getByLabelText(/password/i)` → `getByLabelText(/^password/i)` to disambiguate the "Password" field from the new "Show/Hide password" toggle.
3. [`VehicleCard.test.tsx`](frontend/src/components/VehicleCard.test.tsx:69) — removed the "purchase confirmed" inline-text assertion because confirmations moved to the toast system; kept the stock-update and API-call assertions.
4. [`Modal.test.tsx`](frontend/src/components/Modal.test.tsx:83) — the Tab-wrap assertion now expects the new close button ("Close dialog") as the first focusable element instead of "First".
5. [`VehicleFilters.test.tsx`](frontend/src/components/VehicleFilters.test.tsx:59) — `getByRole('option', { name: 'Sedan' })` → `getByRole('button', { name: 'Sedan' })` since the select became category chips.
6. [`DashboardPage.test.tsx`](frontend/src/pages/DashboardPage.test.tsx:24) — mocked [`ToastContext`](frontend/src/context/ToastContext.tsx:92) and asserted the `toast` calls for add/delete/restock; "Available vehicles" heading → "The showroom floor"; "2 vehicles" → "Total vehicles" stat value; and vehicle lookups switched from combined `findByText('Toyota Model 1')` to the model heading (`findByRole('heading', { name: 'Model 1' })`) because make and model are now rendered as separate elements.

## One supporting source change (not a test)
[`VehicleFilters.tsx`](frontend/src/components/VehicleFilters.tsx:65) now skips its debounce callback on initial mount so opening the dashboard no longer fires a redundant empty-filter request; this preserves the original behavior of only debouncing real user edits.
